--- falls-off-end-switch-all-return @gencs + -D analyzer-optimize
// The analyzer moves each `return switch` below into its cases and drops the switch's @:exhaustive;
// a value no case matches gets gencs's `return default` after the switch.
enum abstract Kind(Int) {
	var A = 1;
	var B = 2;
	var C = 3;
	public function toString():String {
		return switch (cast this : Kind) {
			case A: "A";
			case B: "B";
			case C: "C";
		};
	}
	public static function describe(k:Kind, ?prefix:String):String {
		var p = prefix == null ? "kind " : prefix;
		return switch (k) {
			case A: '${p}a';
			case B: '${p}b';
			case C: '${p}c';
		}
	}
	public static function weight(k:Kind):Int {
		return switch (k) {
			case A: 10;
			case B: 20;
			case C: 30;
		}
	}
	public static function guarded(k:Kind):String {
		try {
			return switch (k) {
				case A: "ga";
				case B: "gb";
				case C: throw "gc";
			}
		} catch (e:String) {
			return "caught " + e;
		}
	}
}
class P {
	static function main() {
		Sys.println("before");
		var k = B;
		Sys.println(k.toString());
		Sys.println(Kind.describe(C) + " " + Kind.describe(A, "-"));
		Sys.println(Kind.weight(A));
		Sys.println(Kind.guarded(A) + " " + Kind.guarded(C));
		var odd:Kind = cast 7;
		Sys.println(odd.toString() == null);
		Sys.println(Kind.weight(odd));
		Sys.println(Kind.guarded(odd) == null);
		Sys.println("after");
	}
}

--- many-locals-and-deep-stack
import haxe.macro.Expr;
class P {
	static var seed = 0;
	static macro function locals(n:Int):Expr {
		var block = [];
		var sum = macro 0;
		for (i in 0...n) {
			var id = "v" + i;
			block.push(macro var $id = P.seed + $v{i});
			sum = macro $sum + $i{id};
		}
		block.push(sum);
		return macro $b{block};
	}
	static macro function nested(n:Int):Expr {
		var e = macro P.seed;
		for (i in 0...n) e = macro P.seed + $v{n - i} + ($e);
		return e;
	}
	@:analyzer(ignore) static function main() {
		Sys.println(locals(300));
		Sys.println(nested(20));
	}
}

--- short-circuit-and-conditions
class P {
	static var flag = true;
	static var calls = 0;
	static function both(x:Bool, y:Bool):Bool return x && y;
	static function either(x:Bool, y:Bool):Bool return x || y;
	static function touch(r:Bool):Bool {
		calls++;
		return r;
	}
	static function pick(x:Bool, y:Bool):Int {
		if (x && y || !x) return 1;
		if (!(x || y)) return 2;
		return 3;
	}
	static function main() {
		Sys.println(both(true, false));
		Sys.println(either(false, true));
		Sys.println(pick(true, true) + pick(false, false) * 10 + pick(true, false) * 100);
		var m = flag && touch(false) && touch(true);
		Sys.println(m + " " + calls);
		var n = !flag || touch(true) || touch(false);
		Sys.println(n + " " + calls);
		if (flag && !touch(false)) Sys.println("then") else Sys.println("else");
		Sys.println(calls);
	}
}

--- classes-and-inheritance @gencs
class Animal {
	public var name:String;
	public function new(name:String) {
		this.name = name;
	}
	public function speak():String {
		return name + " makes a sound";
	}
}
class Dog extends Animal {
	public function new() {
		super("Rex");
	}
	override public function speak():String {
		return super.speak() + ": woof";
	}
}
interface Greeter {
	function greet():String;
}
class Hello implements Greeter {
	public function new() {}
	public function greet():String {
		return "hello";
	}
	public function toString():String {
		return "Hello!";
	}
}
class P {
	static function main() {
		var a:Animal = new Dog();
		Sys.println(a.speak());
		var g:Greeter = new Hello();
		Sys.println(g.greet());
		Sys.println(a.name);
		Sys.println("" + new Hello());
	}
}

	public function new() {}

	public function describe():String return "shape " + area();

		super();
		this.s = s;
	}
	public function area():Float return s * s;
}
interface Named {
	function name():String;
}
interface Titled extends Named {
	function title():String;
}
class Base {
	public function new() {}
	public function name():String return "base";
}
class Sub extends Base implements Titled {
	public function title():String return "Dr " + name();
}
final class Fin implements Named {
	public function new() {}
	public function name():String return "fin";
}
class Over {
	public function new() {}
	@:overload public function f(x:Int):String return "int " + x;
	@:overload public function f(x:String):String return "str " + x;
}
class Res implements cs.system.IDisposable {
	public static var disposed = 0;
	public function new() {}
	public function Dispose():Void disposed++;
}
class Ex extends cs.system.Exception {
	public function new() super("ex");
	@:overload override public function ToString():String return "Ex " + super.ToString().length;
}
class P {
	static function main() {
		var sh:Shape = new Sq(3);
		Sys.println(sh.describe());
		var t:Titled = new Sub();
		var n:Named = t;
		Sys.println(t.title() + " " + n.name());
		n = new Fin();
		Sys.println(n.name());
		var o = new Over();
		Sys.println(o.f(3) + " " + o.f("s"));
		(new Res() : cs.system.IDisposable).Dispose();
		Sys.println(Res.disposed);
		Sys.println(new Ex().ToString());
		var d:Dynamic = sh;
		var sq = cast(d, Sq);
		var back:Sq = cast sh;
		Sys.println(sq.area() + " " + (back == sq));

--- constrained-type-parameters @gencs
class Base {
	public var name:String;
	public function new(name:String) { this.name = name; }
	public function toString() return "Base " + name;
}
class Keyed<K:{}, V> {
	var ks:Array<K>;
	public var last:K;
	var n:Int = 0;
	public function new() { ks = []; }
	public function add(k:K, v:V):Void { ks.push(k); last = k; n++; }
	public function count():Int return n;
	public function pick<S:Base>(s:S):S return s;
}
class Based<K:Base> {
	public var k:K;
	public var n:Int = 7;
	public function new(k:K) { this.k = k; }
	public function show():String return k.name + " " + n;
}
@:nativeGen class NG<K:{}> {
	var n:Int = 2;
	public function new() {}
	public function count():Int return n;
}
class Num<K:Float> {
	public var k:K;
	public var s:String = "str";
	public function new(k:K) { this.k = k; }
	public function show():String return k + " " + s;
}
class P {
	static function main() {
		var g = new Keyed<String, Int>();
		g.add("a", 1);
		g.add("b", 2);
		Sys.println(g.count() + " " + g.last);
		var b = new Base("x");
		Sys.println(g.pick(b));
		var bd = new Based(b);
		Sys.println(bd.show());
		Sys.println(new NG<String>().count());
		Sys.println(new Num<Float>(2.5).show());
		Sys.println(new Num<Int>(3).show());
		var d:Dynamic = bd;
		Sys.println(d.n + " " + d.k);
		Sys.println(Reflect.fields(g).join(","));
		var m = new haxe.ds.ObjectMap<Base, Int>();
		m.set(b, 3);
		Sys.println(m.get(b) + " " + m.exists(new Base("y")));
	}

--- generic-statics-structs-and-uints @dump=Counter`1
class Counter<T> {
	public static var made = start();
	static function start():Int {
		Sys.println("Counter statics");
		return 0;
	}
	static var log = "init";
	public var item:T;
	public function new(item:T) {
		this.item = item;
		made++;
	}
	public static function describe():String {
		return log + " " + made;
	}
	public function boxed():Dynamic {
		return item;
	}
	public function orDefault(useDefault:Bool):T {
		if (useDefault) return null;
		return item;
	}
	public function map<S>(s:S):Pair<T, S> {
		return new Pair(item, s);
	}
}
class Pair<A, B> {

--- exceptions @gencs
class MyError extends cs.system.Exception {
	public var code:Int;
	public function new(code:Int) {
		super("my error");
		this.code = code;
	}
}
class P {
	static function fail(n:Int):Int {
		if (n > 2) throw new MyError(n);
		return n;
	}
	static function attempt(n:Int):String {
		try {
			return "ok " + fail(n);
		} catch (e:MyError) {
			return "caught " + e.code + " " + e.Message;
		} catch (e:cs.system.Exception) {
			return "other";
		}
	}
	static function main() {
		Sys.println(attempt(1));
		Sys.println(attempt(5));
		var count = 0;
		for (i in 0...5) {
			try {
				if (i == 1) continue;
				if (i == 3) break;
				count += 10;
			} catch (e:cs.system.Exception) {}
		}
		Sys.println(count);
		var v = try fail(9) catch (e:MyError) -e.code;
		Sys.println(v);
		Sys.println(1 + (try fail(1) catch (e:MyError) 0));
		try {
			try throw new cs.system.ArgumentException("inner") catch (e:MyError) Sys.println("wrong");
		} catch (e:cs.system.ArgumentException) {
			Sys.println("outer " + e.Message);
		}
	}
}

--- jumps-out-of-nested-regions
class P {
	static var hits = 0;
	static function nested(n:Int):String {
		try {
			try {
				if (n == 0) return "inner";
				throw new cs.system.ArgumentException("x");
			} catch (e:cs.system.ArgumentException) {
				if (n == 1) return "from catch";
				try {
					throw new cs.system.InvalidOperationException("y");
				} catch (e2:cs.system.InvalidOperationException) {
					return "try in catch " + e2.Message;
				}
			}
		} catch (e:cs.system.Exception) {
			return "outer";
		}
	}
	static function loops():Int {
		var total = 0;
		var i = 0;
		while (i < 10) {
			i++;
			try {
				var j = 0;
				while (j < 10) {
					j++;
					try {
						if (j == 2) continue;
						if (j > 3) break;
						total += j;
					} catch (e:cs.system.Exception) {}
				}
				if (i == 2) continue;
				if (i == 4) break;
				total += 100;
			} catch (e:cs.system.Exception) {
				break;
			}
		}
		return total;
	}
	static function voidReturn(n:Int):Void {
		try {
			if (n > 0) return;
			hits += 1;
		} catch (e:cs.system.Exception) {
			return;
		}
		hits += 10;
	}
	static function rethrow():String {
		try {
			try {
				throw new cs.system.ArgumentException("again");
			} catch (e:cs.system.ArgumentException) {
				throw e;
			}
		} catch (e:cs.system.Exception) {
			return e.Message;
		}
	}
	static function main() {
		Sys.println(nested(0));
		Sys.println(nested(1));
		Sys.println(nested(2));
		Sys.println(loops());
		voidReturn(1);
		voidReturn(0);
		Sys.println(hits);
		Sys.println(rethrow());
	}
}

--- inventory @gencs
class Item {
	public var name:String;
	public var qty:Int;
	public function new(name:String, qty:Int) {
		this.name = name;
		this.qty = qty;
	}
	public function toString():String {
		return name + " x" + qty;
	}
}
class OutOfStock extends cs.system.Exception {
	public function new(name:String) {
		super(name + " is out of stock");
	}
}
class Inventory {
	static var created = 0;
	var items:Array<Item> = [];
	public function new() {
		created++;
	}
	public function add(name:String, qty:Int):Void {
		items.push(new Item(name, qty));
	}
	public function take(name:String):Item {
		for (it in items) {
			if (it.name == name) {
				if (it.qty == 0) throw new OutOfStock(name);
				it.qty--;
				return it;
			}
		}
		throw new cs.system.ArgumentException("no " + name);
	}
	public static function count():Int {
		return created;
	}
}
class P {
	static function main() {
		var inv = new Inventory();
		inv.add("apple", 1);
		inv.add("pear", 0);
		Sys.println("" + inv.take("apple"));
		for (n in ["apple", "pear", "plum"]) {
			try {
				inv.take(n);
			} catch (e:OutOfStock) {
				Sys.println(e.Message);
			} catch (e:cs.system.ArgumentException) {
				Sys.println("error: " + e.Message);
			}
		}
		Sys.println(Inventory.count());
	}
}

--- lock-refs-and-magic-identifiers @gencs
class P {
	static var count = 0;
	@:volatile static var flag = 1;

	static function locked(n:Int):Int {
		cs.Lib.lock(P, {
			if (n > 2)
				return n * 10;
			count += n;
		});
		return count;
	}

	static function bump(r:cs.Ref<Int>, by:Int):Void {
		r += by;
		var copy = r;
		r = copy * 2;
	}

	static function main() {
		Sys.println(locked(1));
		Sys.println(locked(5));
		var i = 0;
		while (i < 10) {
			cs.Lib.lock(P, {
				i++;
				if (i == 3)
					break;
			});
		}
		Sys.println(i);
		var o:Dynamic = "text";
		var s:String = cs.Lib.as(o, String);
		Sys.println(s);
		var n:Dynamic = 5;
		Sys.println(cs.Lib.as(n, String) == null);
		var isString:Bool = untyped __is__(o, String);
		var isInt:Bool = untyped __is__(o, Int);
		Sys.println(isString + " " + isInt);
		var t:cs.system.Type = untyped __typeof__(String);
		Sys.println(t.FullName);
		var x = 1;
		bump(x, 41);
		Sys.println(x);
		var str = "AZ";
		var c:Int = cast str[1];
		Sys.println(c);
		flag += 2;
		Sys.println(flag);
	}
}

		trail += "base " + n + " " + this.n + ",";

class Mid extends Base {
	var tag = "m";
}
class Leaf extends Mid {
	var extra = "x";
	public function new() {
		Base.trail += "leaf before " + extra + ",";
		super(7);
		Base.trail += "leaf after " + tag + " " + log.length + " " + log[0] + ",";

# Overloads whose Haxe types differ only in type arguments, which erasure makes one CLR signature
# (``f(Array`1<object>)``): two such MethodDefs are invalid metadata, and a call through Dynamic could
# reach either. gencs's C# for them fails with CS0111, so the class or interface is refused, methods
# and constructors alike, a generic interface's companion included.
--- erased-identical-overloads-is-an-error
class C { public function new() {} }
class D { public function new() {} }
class Q {
	public function new() {}
	@:overload public function f(a:Array<C>):String return "C";
	@:overload public function f(a:Array<D>):String return "D";
}
class R {
	@:overload public function new(a:Array<C>) {}
	@:overload public function new(a:Array<D>) {}
}
interface I<T> {
	@:overload function f(a:Array<C>):String;
	@:overload function f(a:Array<D>):String;
}
interface J {
	@:overload function f(a:Array<C>):String;
	@:overload function f(a:Array<D>):String;
}
class P {
	static function main() {
		var d:Dynamic = new Q();
		Sys.println(d.f([new D()]));
		new R([new C()]);
	}
}

		super(m);

class Kinds<T> {
	public var u:UInt = 1;
	public var sg:Single = 1.5;
	public var ni:Null<Int>;
	public var b:Bool = true;
	public var s:String = "s";
	public var d:Dynamic = null;

		this.t = t;

	function get_p1() return 11;
	function set_p1(v) {
		u = v;
		return v;
	}
	function get_p2() return p2 + 100;
	function set_p2(v) return p2 = v * 2;
	function get_p5() return 1.25;
	public function vm(x:Int):Void {
		u = x;
	}
	public function two(a:Int, b:String):String return a + "," + b;
	public function useT(x:T):T return x;
}

	static function set(o:Dynamic, f:String, v:Dynamic) Reflect.setField(o, f, v);

		Sys.println(Reflect.fields(k).join(","));

		show(k, "ni");

		show(k, "b");

		show(k, "s");
		set(k, "t", "tt");
		show(k, "t");

		show(k, "col");
		set(k, "p2", 4);
		show(k, "p2");

		Sys.println(Reflect.getProperty(k, "p2"));
		Reflect.setProperty(k, "p1", 21);
		show(k, "u");
		try set(k, "ro", 1) catch (e:cs.system.MemberAccessException) Sys.println("ro: " + e.Message);
		try set(k, "p5", 1) catch (e:cs.system.MemberAccessException) Sys.println("p5: " + e.Message);
		Sys.println(Reflect.hasField(k, "vm") + " " + Reflect.hasField(k, "zz"));
		Sys.println(Reflect.isFunction(Reflect.field(k, "two")));
		for (f in ["u", "sg", "d", "p1", "p2", "p3", "p5"]) Sys.println(f + "_f=" + Runtime.getField_f(k, f, 0, false));
		Runtime.setField_f(k, "u", 0, 3.7);
		show(k, "u");
		Runtime.setField_f(k, "sg", 0, 0.5);
		show(k, "sg");

--- net-enum-values @gencs
import cs.system.reflection.BindingFlags;
class Foo {
	public function new() {}
}
class P {
	static function code(o:Dynamic):Int {
		var t = cs.Lib.as(o, cs.system.IConvertible).GetTypeCode();
		if (t == cs.system.TypeCode.String) return 100;
		switch (t) {
			case Double: return 1;
			case Int32, UInt32: return 2;
			default: return 3;
		}
	}
	static function half(f:Float):Float return f / 2;
	static function show(o:Dynamic):Void Sys.println(o);
	static function flags():BindingFlags return cast((cast BindingFlags.Public : Int) | (cast BindingFlags.Static : Int));
	static function ret():Dynamic return (cast flags() : Int);
	static inline function inlI(x:Int):Int return x;
	static inline function inlF(x:Float):Float return x;
	static function main() {
		var bf = flags();
		Sys.println(bf);
		Sys.println(bf == BindingFlags.Public);
		Sys.println(code(1.5) + " " + code(7) + " " + code("s") + " " + code(true));
		var t1 = cs.system.TypeCode.Int32, t2 = cs.system.TypeCode.Int64;
		switch [t1, t2] {
			case [Int64, _] | [_, Int64]: Sys.println("i64");
			case _: Sys.println("other");
		}
		var dt:Dynamic = cs.system.TypeCode.Decimal;
		Sys.println(dt);
		// A cast of the enum to Int in each position.
		Sys.println((cast bf : Int));
		show((cast bf : Int));
		var d:Dynamic = (cast bf : Int);
		Sys.println(d);
		Sys.println(ret());
		var i:Int = (cast bf : Int);
		Sys.println(i);
		Sys.println((cast bf : Int) + 1);
		var f:Float = (cast bf : Int);
		Sys.println(f);
		Sys.println(half((cast bf : Int)));
		Sys.println((cast bf : Int) / 2);
		Sys.println("s" + (cast bf : Int));
		Sys.println(inlI((cast bf : Int)));
		Sys.println(inlF((cast bf : Int)));
		var k:Dynamic = (cast bf : UInt);
		Sys.println(k);
		var x:Float = cast (cast bf : Int);
		Sys.println(x);
		var z:Dynamic = (cast (cast bf : Int) : Float);
		Sys.println(z);
		// A cast to Dynamic of another cast drops the inner one in gencs, whatever is cast.
		var dd:Dynamic = 2.75;
		Sys.println((cast dd : Int));
		var fl = 2.5;
		Sys.println((cast fl : Int));
		var o:Dynamic = "str";
		Sys.println(cast(o, Foo));
		var bd:Dynamic = bf;
		Sys.println((cast bd : Int));
	}
}

--- nested-casts-collapse-as-gencs @gencs
interface IFace {}
class Base {
	public function new() {}
	public function toString() return "Base";
}
class Sub extends Base implements IFace {
	public function new() super();
}
class Impl implements IFace {
	public function new() {}
	public function toString() return "Impl";
}
class P {
	static function show(o:Dynamic) Sys.println(o);
	static function takeFloat(f:Float) Sys.println(f);
	static function takeInt(i:Int) Sys.println(i);
	static function main() {
		var fl = 2.5;
		var o1:Dynamic = (cast (cast fl : Int) : cs.system.Object);
		show(o1);
		var o2:Dynamic = (cast (cast fl : Int) : {});
		show(o2);
		var o3:Dynamic = (cast (cast fl : Int) : {x:Int});
		show(o3);
		var o4:Dynamic = (cast (cast fl : Int) : EnumValue);
		show(o4);
		var o5:Dynamic = (cast (cast fl : Int) : Dynamic);
		show(o5);
		var o6:Dynamic = (cast (cast fl : Int) : Null<Int>);
		show(o6);
		var o7:Float = (cast (cast fl : Int) : Float);
		show(o7);
		var bd:Dynamic = new Base();
		try show((cast (cast bd : Sub) : Base)) catch (e:Dynamic) show("threw");
		var im:Dynamic = new Impl();
		try show((cast (cast im : Sub) : IFace)) catch (e:Dynamic) show("threw");
		var sd:Dynamic = new Sub();
		show((cast (cast sd : Base) : cs.system.Object));
		try show((cast (cast bd : Sub) : cs.system.Object)) catch (e:Dynamic) show("threw");
		var b:Base = (cast (cast bd : Sub) : Base);
		show(b);
		show((cast fl : Null<Int>));
		var n1:Dynamic = (cast (cast fl : Int) : Null<Int>);
		show(n1);
		var n2:Float = (cast (cast fl : Null<Int>) : Float);
		show(n2);
		var n3:Int = (cast (cast fl : Null<Int>) : Int);
		show(n3);
		var n4:Dynamic = (cast (cast fl : Null<Int>) : cs.system.Object);
		show(n4);
		var n5:Null<Float> = (cast (cast fl : Null<Int>) : Null<Float>);
		show(n5);
		var n6:String = (cast (cast fl : Null<Int>) : String);
		show(n6);
		takeFloat((cast fl : Null<Int>));
		takeInt((cast fl : Null<Int>));
		var dd:Dynamic = 3.5;
		takeFloat((cast dd : Null<Int>));
		show((cast dd : Null<Int>));
		var ni:Null<Int> = (cast fl : Null<Int>);
		show(ni);
		show((cast fl : Null<Int>) + 1);
	}
}

	public function new() {}

class Foo {

	static function t():Bool return Std.random(1) == 0;
	static function takeInt(x:Int):Int return x;
	static function takeFloat(x:Float):Float return x;
	static function kind(x:Dynamic):String {
		if (x == null) return "null";
		var o:cs.system.Object = x;
		return o.GetType().Name + ":" + Std.string(x);
	}
	static function main() {

import cs.StdTypes.Int64;
import cs.StdTypes.UInt64;
class P {
	static function main() {
		var a:Int64 = 5000000000;
		var b:Int64 = 3;
		var i = 7;
		Sys.println(a + b);
		Sys.println(a - b);
		Sys.println(a * b);
		Sys.println(a / b);
		Sys.println(a % b);
		Sys.println(-a);
		Sys.println((a | b) + " " + (a & b) + " " + (a ^ b) + " " + ~b);
		Sys.println((a << 2) + " " + (a >> 1) + " " + (-a >> 1));
		Sys.println(a + i);
		Sys.println(i * a);
		Sys.println(cast(a, Float) / 2.0);
		var f = 1.5e10;
		// gencs drops a checked cast to Int64/Int here: the Float (and the Int64) print unchanged.
		Sys.println(cast(f, Int64));
		Sys.println(cast(-2.7, Int64));
		Sys.println(cast(a, Int));
		var c = a;
		c += b;
		c++;
		c *= 2;
		Sys.println(c);
		Sys.println((a > b) + " " + (a == 5000000000) + " " + (b < i));
		var u:UInt64 = 18446744073709551615;
		Sys.println(u);
		// UInt64 / Int is C#'s integer division under gencs, though Haxe types it Float.
		Sys.println(u / 2);
		var max:Int64 = 9223372036854775807;
		Sys.println(max + 1);
		var h = haxe.Int64.make(1, 2);
		Sys.println(h + " " + haxe.Int64.toStr(h) + " " + h.high + " " + h.low);
		var x = haxe.Int64.ofInt(-7);
		Sys.println(haxe.Int64.toStr(x * h + 1) + " " + haxe.Int64.div(h, 3) + " " + haxe.Int64.mod(h, 3) + " " + haxe.Int64.compare(x, h));
		Sys.println(haxe.Int64.toInt(haxe.Int64.ofInt(42)) + " " + haxe.Int64.isNeg(x) + " " + haxe.Int64.isZero(x - x));
		Sys.println(haxe.Int64.parseString("-9223372036854775808") + " " + haxe.Int64.fromFloat(1e15));
		try haxe.Int64.toInt(h) catch (e:Dynamic) Sys.println("overflow: " + e);
		var d:Dynamic = a;
		Sys.println(Std.string(d) + " " + Std.isOfType(d, Int) + " " + Std.isOfType(d, Float));
	}

--- date-time @gencs
class P {
	// The same wall-clock time as milliseconds since 1970 in UTC, whatever the machine's time zone.
	static function wall(d:Date):Float return d.getTime() - d.getTimezoneOffset() * 60000.0;
	static function main() {
		var d = new Date(2000, 0, 1, 0, 0, 0);
		Sys.println(wall(d));
		Sys.println(wall(new Date(2020, 1, 29, 13, 45, 30)));
		var t = 1234567890123.0;
		var u = Date.fromTime(t);
		Sys.println(u.getTime() == t);
		Sys.println(u.getUTCFullYear() + "-" + u.getUTCMonth() + "-" + u.getUTCDate() + " " + u.getUTCHours() + ":" + u.getUTCMinutes() + ":" + u.getUTCSeconds() + " day " + u.getUTCDay());
		Sys.println(Date.fromTime(0).getUTCFullYear() + " " + Date.fromTime(-86400000.0).getUTCDate() + " " + Date.fromTime(0.5).getTime());
		var s = Date.fromString("2001-02-03 04:05:06");
		Sys.println(s.toString() + " " + wall(s));
		Sys.println(Date.fromString("10:20:30").getTime());
		Sys.println(wall(Date.fromString("2001-02-03")));
		Sys.println(DateTools.format(s, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"));
		Sys.println(DateTools.format(s, "%d/%m/%y %I %p %e"));
		Sys.println(wall(DateTools.delta(s, DateTools.days(1.5))));
		Sys.println(DateTools.getMonthDays(new Date(2024, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0)) + " " + DateTools.getMonthDays(new Date(2023, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0)));
		Sys.println(Date.now().getTime() > t);
		try Date.fromString("bad") catch (e:String) Sys.println(e);
	}
}

--- int64-checked-casts @gencs
import cs.StdTypes.Int64;
import cs.StdTypes.UInt64;
class P {
	static function show(v:Dynamic) Sys.println(v);
	static inline function ishow(v:Dynamic) Sys.println(v);
	static function main() {
		var a:Int64 = 5000000000;
		var f = -2.7;
		var i = 3;
		// A checked cast to or from a 64-bit integer converts, except as an argument inlined into a
		// Dynamic parameter, where gencs's outer cast to Dynamic replaces it.
		Sys.println(cast(f, Int64));
		Sys.println(cast(a, Int));
		ishow(cast(f, Int64));
		ishow(cast(a, Int));
		show(cast(f, Int64));
		show(cast(a, Int));
		cs.system.Console.WriteLine(cast(f, Int64));
		var d1:Dynamic = cast(f, Int64);
		var d2:Dynamic = cast(a, Int);
		var d3:Dynamic = cast(i, Int64);
		Sys.println(d1 + " " + d2 + " " + d3);
		Sys.println(Std.isOfType(d1, Float) + " " + Std.isOfType(d2, Int) + " " + Std.isOfType(d3, Int));
		var arr:Array<Dynamic> = [cast(f, Int64), cast(a, Int), cast(i, Int64)];
		Sys.println(arr);
		Sys.println(Std.string(cast(f, Int64)) + " " + Std.string(cast(a, Int)));
		Sys.println(cast(f, Int64) + 0.5);
		// gencs types an operator on a UInt and an Int64 or UInt64 as UInt, but not `/`.

		Sys.println((a / ui) + " " + (v + ui) + " " + (v - ui) + " " + (a > ui));
	}

--- type-fields-and-class-equality @gencs
class Shape {
	public var name:String;
	var secret:Int = 1;
	public final id:Int = 7;
	@:isVar public var w(get, set):Float = 0;
	public var ro(default, null):Int = 0;
	public static var count:Int = 0;
	static var hiddenStatic:Int = 0;
	public static inline var K = 3;
	function get_w() return w;
	function set_w(v) return w = v;
	public function new(n:String) {
		name = n;
		count++;
	}
	public function area():Float return 0;
	function priv() return 2;
	public static function make() return new Shape("s");
}
class Square extends Shape {
	public var side:Float = 2;
	public function new() super("sq");
	override public function area():Float return side * side;
	public function extra() return priv();
}
class P {
	static function main() {
		var s:Shape = new Square();
		s.w = 1;
		cast(s, Square).extra();
		Shape.make();
		Sys.println(Type.getInstanceFields(Shape).join(","));
		Sys.println(Type.getInstanceFields(Square).join(","));
		Sys.println(Type.getClassFields(Shape).join(","));
		Sys.println(Type.getClassFields(Square).length);
		Sys.println(Type.getInstanceFields(String).join(","));
		Sys.println(Type.getClassFields(String).join(","));
		Sys.println(Reflect.fields(Shape).join(","));
		Sys.println(Reflect.fields("abc").length);
		Sys.println(Reflect.fields(new cs.system.Version(1, 2)).length);
		Sys.println(Type.getClass(s) == Square);
		Sys.println(Type.getClass(s) != Shape);
		Sys.println(Type.getSuperClass(Square) == Shape);
		Sys.println(Type.getSuperClass(Shape) == null);
		Sys.println(Type.resolveClass("Square") == Square);
		Sys.println(Type.resolveClass("Nope") == null);
		var c:Class<Dynamic> = Type.getClass(s);
		Sys.println(c == Square && c != null);
	}
}

--- reflect-api @gencs
class C {
	public var x:Int = 1;
	public var s:String = "s";
	public var p(get, set):Int;
	var hidden:Int = 9;
	function get_p() return x * 10;
	function set_p(v) return x = v;
	public static var st:Int = 4;
	public static function sm(a:Int) return a + 1;
	public function new() {}
	public function m(a:Int, b:Int) return a + b + x;
}
class P {
	static function main() {
		var c = new C();
		var o:Dynamic = {a: 1, b: "two"};
		Sys.println(Reflect.fields(c).join(",") + " / " + Reflect.fields(o).join(","));
		Sys.println(Reflect.hasField(c, "x") + " " + Reflect.hasField(c, "m") + " " + Reflect.hasField(c, "p") + " " + Reflect.hasField(c, "hidden") + " " + Reflect.hasField(c, "zz") + " " + Reflect.hasField(o, "a") + " " + Reflect.hasField(o, "zz"));
		Sys.println(Reflect.getProperty(c, "p") + " " + Reflect.field(c, "p"));
		Reflect.setProperty(c, "p", 3);
		Reflect.setProperty(o, "a", 5);
		Sys.println(c.x + " " + Reflect.getProperty(o, "a"));
		Sys.println(Reflect.deleteField(o, "a") + " " + Reflect.deleteField(o, "a") + " " + Reflect.fields(o).join(",") + " " + Reflect.deleteField(c, "x"));
		var cp = Reflect.copy(o);
		cp.b = "changed";
		Sys.println(o.b + " " + cp.b);
		var cc:Dynamic = Reflect.copy((c : Dynamic));
		Sys.println(Std.string(cc) + " " + Std.isOfType(cc, C));
		Sys.println(Reflect.copy(null));
		Sys.println(Reflect.isObject(c) + " " + Reflect.isObject(o) + " " + Reflect.isObject("s") + " " + Reflect.isObject(1) + " " + Reflect.isObject(C) + " " + Reflect.isObject([1]) + " " + Reflect.isObject(true));

--- std-parse-and-int @gencs
class P {
	static function esc(s:String) return s.split("\t").join("\\t").split("\n").join("\\n");
	static function main() {
		var ins = ["0", "12", "-12", "+12", "  42", "\t\n7", "12abc", "abc", "", " ", "-", "+", "0x1F", "0X1f", "-0x10", "0x", "0xG", "2147483647", "2147483648", "-2147483648", "99999999999", "0xFFFFFFFF", "0x80000000", "1.9", "1e3", " -0", "00012"];
		for (s in ins) {
			var r = try Std.string(Std.parseInt(s)) catch (e:cs.system.OverflowException) "OverflowException";
			Sys.println("parseInt('" + esc(s) + "') = " + r);
		}
		Sys.println(Std.parseInt(null));
		var fs = ["0", "1.5", "-1.5", "+1.5", "  2.5", "1e3", "1E-3", "1e", "1e+", "1e-", "1.5e3x", ".5", "5.", "-.5", "abc", "", "1.2.3", "--1", "+-1", "1,5", "Infinity", "NaN", "0x10", "1e-400", "12abc", "\t3", " .", "e5", "-", "1_000"];
		for (s in fs) Sys.println("parseFloat('" + esc(s) + "') = " + Std.parseFloat(s));
		Sys.println(Std.parseFloat(null));
		var xs:Array<Float> = [0.0, 2.5, -2.5, 2.9999, -2.9999, 2147483647.0, 2147483648.0, -2147483649.0, 1e20, -1e20, Math.NaN];
		for (x in xs) Sys.println("int(" + x + ") = " + Std.int(x));
		var ok = true;
		for (i in 0...1000) {
			var r = Std.random(10);
			if (r < 0 || r >= 10) ok = false;
			var f = Math.random();
			if (f < 0 || f >= 1) ok = false;
		}
		Sys.println(ok + " " + Std.random(0) + " " + Std.random(-5) + " " + Std.random(1));
	}
}

class Shape {
	public var n:Int;
	public function new(n) this.n = n;

class Tree<K> {
	public function new() {}
	function compare(a:K, b:K):Int return 0;
	public function cmp(a:K, b:K):Int return compare(a, b);
}
class ShapeTree<K:Shape> extends Tree<K> {
	public function new() super();
	override function compare(a:Shape, b:Shape):Int return a.n - b.n;
}

--- override-changes-signature-shapes @gencs
class Animal {
	public var name:String;
	public function new(n) name = n;
}
class Dog extends Animal {
	public function new() super("dog");
}
class Tree<K> {
	public function new() {}
	function compare(a:K, b:K):Int return 0;
	public function cmp(a:K, b:K):Int return compare(a, b);
	public function pick(a:K, b:K):K return a;
}
class DynTree<K> extends Tree<K> {
	public function new() super();
	override function compare(a:Dynamic, b:Dynamic):Int return Reflect.compare(a, b);
	override public function pick(a:K, b:Dynamic):K return b;
}
class Keeper {
	public function new() {}
	public function feed(d:Dog, times:Int):String return "keeper " + times;
	public function call(d:Dog):String return feed(d, 1);
	public function pet():Animal return new Animal("pet");
}
interface Feeds {
	function feed(a:Animal, times:Int):String;
}
class Vet extends Keeper implements Feeds {
	public function new() super();
	override public function feed(a:Animal, times:Int):String return "vet " + a.name + " " + times;
	override public function pet():Dog return new Dog();
}
class P {
	static function params(c:Class<Dynamic>, name:String) {
		var out = [];
		for (m in cs.Lib.toNativeType(c).GetMethods()) if (m.Name == name && m.DeclaringType == cs.Lib.toNativeType(c)) {
			var ps = [for (p in m.GetParameters()) p.ParameterType.Name + " " + p.Name];
			out.push(m.ReturnType.Name + "(" + ps.join(", ") + ")" + (m.GetBaseDefinition() != m ? " override" : ""));
		}
		Sys.println(name + ": " + out.join(" / "));
	}
	static function main() {
		var t = new DynTree<Int>();
		Sys.println(t.cmp(5, 2));
		var u:Tree<Int> = t;
		Sys.println(u.cmp(1, 4) + " " + u.pick(1, 2) + " " + t.pick(3, 4));
		var v = new Vet();
		Sys.println(v.call(new Dog()));
		Sys.println(v.feed(new Animal("cat"), 2));
		var k:Keeper = v;
		Sys.println(k.feed(new Dog(), 3));
		Sys.println(v.pet().name + " " + k.pet().name);
		var j:Feeds = v;
		Sys.println(j.feed(new Dog(), 4));
		params(DynTree, "compare");
		params(DynTree, "pick");
		params(Vet, "feed");
		Sys.println(Type.getInstanceFields(Vet).join(","));
	}
}

--- enum-switch @gencs
enum Color {
	Red;
	Green;
	Blue;
}
enum E {
	A;
	B(x:Int, s:String);
	C(f:Float);
	D(e:E);
}
class P {
	static function name(c:Color):String {
		return switch (c) {
			case Red: "r";
			case Green: "g";
			case Blue: "b";
		}
	}
	static function desc(e:E):String {
		return switch (e) {
			case A: "a";
			case B(x, s) if (x > 10): "big " + s;
			case B(x, "q"): "q" + x;
			case B(1 | 2, s): "small " + s;
			case B(x, s): "b" + x + s;
			case D(D(inner)): "dd " + inner;
			case D(B(_, s)): "db " + s;
			case D(_): "d";
			case _: "other";
		}
	}
	static function main() {
		Sys.println(name(Red) + name(Green) + name(Blue));
		Sys.println(desc(A));
		Sys.println(desc(B(11, "x")));
		Sys.println(desc(B(1, "q")));
		Sys.println(desc(B(2, "w")));
		Sys.println(desc(B(5, "v")));
		Sys.println(desc(D(D(A))));
		Sys.println(desc(D(B(0, "k"))));
		Sys.println(desc(D(C(2))));
		Sys.println(desc(C(0.5)));
		var e = B(3, "t");
		switch (e) {
			case B(x, _):
				Sys.println(x * 2);
			default:
		}
		Sys.println(e.match(B(3, _)));
		Sys.println(e.match(B(4, _)));
		var n:Null<Color> = null;
		Sys.println(switch (n) {
			case null: "null";
			case Red: "red";
			case _: "other";
		});
		n = Red;
		Sys.println(switch (n) {
			case null: "null";
			case Red: "red";
			case _: "other";
		});
		Sys.println(Type.enumIndex(e) + Type.enumIndex(Blue));
	}
}

--- null-reference-equality-from-generic-call @gencs
enum Color {
	Red;
	Green;
}
class Thing {
	public function new() {}
}
class P {
	var prev:Map<String, Color> = [];
	function new() {}
	function changed(k:String, c:Color):Bool {
		var r = !prev.exists(k) || prev.get(k) != c;
		prev.set(k, c);
		return r;
	}
	static function main() {
		var p = new P();
		Sys.println(p.changed("a", Red));
		Sys.println(p.changed("a", Red));
		Sys.println(p.changed("a", Green));
		Sys.println(Green == p.prev.get("a"));
		Sys.println(p.prev.get("b") == Red);
		var t = new Thing();
		var things = ["t" => t];
		Sys.println(things.get("t") == t);
		Sys.println(t != things.get("u"));
	}
}

--- enum-generic-params @gencs
enum Opt<T> {
	Some(v:T);
	None;
}
enum Tree<T> {
	Leaf(v:T);
	Node(l:Tree<T>, r:Tree<T>);
}
class P {
	static function sum(t:Tree<Int>):Int {
		return switch (t) {
			case Leaf(v): v;
			case Node(l, r): sum(l) + sum(r);
		}
	}
	static function get<T>(o:Opt<T>, def:T):T {
		return switch (o) {
			case Some(v): v;
			case None: def;
		}
	}
	static function main() {
		Sys.println(sum(Node(Leaf(1), Node(Leaf(2), Leaf(3)))));
		var o = Some([1, 2]);
		switch (o) {
			case Some(a):
				a.push(3);
			case None:
		}
		switch (o) {
			case Some(a):
				Sys.println(a.length + " " + a);
			case None:
		}
		var s:Opt<String> = Some("hi");
		switch (s) {
			case Some(str):
				Sys.println(str.length);
			case None:
		}
		var f:Opt<Float> = Some(2);
		switch (f) {
			case Some(v):
				Sys.println(v / 4);
			case None:
		}
		Sys.println(get(Some(5), 0) + get(None, 10));
		Sys.println(get(None, "d") + get(Some("e"), "x"));
		var t:Tree<String> = Node(Leaf("a"), Leaf(null));
		Sys.println(t);
	}
}

--- enum-serialize @gencs @module=pk.Ser
package pk;

import haxe.Serializer;
import haxe.Unserializer;

enum Kind {
	Leaf;
	Node(l:Kind, r:Kind);
	Val(i:Int, ?tag:String);
}
enum Color {
	Red;
	Green;
	Blue;
}
enum Opt<T> {
	Some(v:T);
	None;
}
enum Num {
	I(i:Int);
	F(f:Float);
	N(?n:Int);
}
class Ser {
	static function show(v:Dynamic):Void {
		var plain = Serializer.run(v);
		var s = new Serializer();
		s.useEnumIndex = true;
		s.serialize(v);
		var indexed = s.toString();
		var c = new Serializer();
		c.useCache = true;
		c.serialize(v);
		var back:Dynamic = Unserializer.run(plain);
		var back2:Dynamic = Unserializer.run(indexed);
		Sys.println(plain + " | " + indexed + " | " + c.toString() + " | " + Std.string(back) + " " + Type.enumEq(back, v) + " "
			+ Std.string(back2));
	}
	static function main() {
		show(Red);
		show(Node(Leaf, Val(3, "t")));
		show(Val(1));
		show(Some("s"));
		show(None);
		show(Some(Blue));
		show(I(-5));
		show(F(2.5));
		show(F(3));
		show(N());
		show(N(4));
		var arr:Array<Dynamic> = [Red, Red, Green];
		Sys.println(Serializer.run(arr));
		var k = Val(9, "u");
		var c = new Serializer();
		c.useCache = true;
		c.serialize([k, k, Leaf, Leaf]);
		Sys.println(c.toString());
		var u:Dynamic = Unserializer.run(c.toString());
		Sys.println(u[0] == u[1]);
		Sys.println(u[2] == Leaf);
		var col:Color = Unserializer.run("wy8:pk.Colory4:Blue:0");
		Sys.println(col == Blue);
		Sys.println(Std.string(Unserializer.run("wy7:pk.Kindy3:Val:2i8n")));
		Sys.println(Std.string(Unserializer.run("jy7:pk.Kind:1:2jR0:0:0jR0:2:2i5n")));
	}
}

--- exception-stack-and-details @gencs
import haxe.CallStack;
class P {
	// Long enough that the JIT does not inline it, so its frame shows in both builds.
	static function thrower(n:Int):Int {
		var acc = 0;
		for (i in 0...n) {
			acc += i * 31 + (acc >> 3);
			if (acc > 1000000) acc = acc % 977;
		}
		if (n > 0) throw new haxe.Exception("boom " + n + " " + acc);
		return acc;
	}
	static function main() {
		try thrower(3) catch (e:haxe.Exception) {
			Sys.println(e.details());
			Sys.println("--");
			for (item in e.stack) Sys.println(Std.string(item));
			Sys.println("--");
			Sys.println(CallStack.toString(e.stack));
			Sys.println("--");
			switch (e.stack[0]) {
				case FilePos(Method(cls, meth), file, line, _): Sys.println(cls + "." + meth + " " + file + " " + line);
				case _: Sys.println("other");
			}
		}
		try throw "v" catch (e:haxe.Exception) Sys.println(e.details());
		Sys.println("--");
		Sys.println(CallStack.toString(CallStack.callStack()));
		Sys.println(CallStack.exceptionStack().length);
		var inner = new haxe.Exception("inner");
		var outer = new haxe.Exception("outer", inner);
		Sys.println(outer.details());
		Sys.println(outer.previous == inner);
	}
}

import haxe.exceptions.*;
class MyErr extends haxe.Exception {
	public var code:Int;
	public function new(code:Int, ?prev:haxe.Exception) {
		super("my " + code, prev);
		this.code = code;
	}
	override function toString() return "MyErr(" + message + ")";
}
class P {
	static function name(v:Dynamic) return Type.getClassName(Type.getClass(v));
	static function main() {
		try throw "str" catch (e:String) Sys.println("String " + e);
		try throw 42 catch (e:Int) Sys.println("Int " + e);
		try throw 7 catch (e:Float) Sys.println("Int as Float " + e);
		try throw true catch (e:Bool) Sys.println("Bool " + e);
		try throw "dyn" catch (e:Dynamic) Sys.println("Dynamic " + e + " " + name(e));
		try throw null catch (e:Dynamic) Sys.println("null " + (e == null));
		try throw null catch (e:haxe.Exception) Sys.println("null as Exception " + e.message + " " + (e.unwrap() == null) + " " + name(e));
		try throw new MyErr(3) catch (e:MyErr) Sys.println("MyErr " + e.code + " " + e.message + " " + e);
		try throw new MyErr(4) catch (e:haxe.Exception) Sys.println("as Exception " + Std.string(e) + " " + Std.isOfType(e, MyErr));
		try throw new MyErr(5, new haxe.Exception("root")) catch (e:Dynamic) Sys.println("as Dynamic " + Std.string(e) + " <- " + (e : haxe.Exception).previous.message);
		try throw "val" catch (e:haxe.Exception) Sys.println("wrapped " + e.message + " " + name(e) + " " + Std.string((cast e : haxe.ValueException).value));
		try throw {x: 2} catch (e:haxe.ValueException) Sys.println("ValueException " + Std.string(e.value) + " " + e.message);
		try throw 1.5 catch (e:haxe.Exception) Sys.println(e.toString() + " " + Std.isOfType(e.unwrap(), Float));
		try throw new cs.system.ArgumentException("native") catch (e:haxe.Exception) Sys.println("native as Exception " + e.message + " " + name(e) + " " + name(e.native) + " " + (e.unwrap() == e.native));
		try throw new cs.system.ArgumentException("arg") catch (e:Dynamic) Sys.println("native as Dynamic " + name(e));
		try throw new MyErr(6) catch (e:cs.system.Exception) Sys.println("haxe as native " + e.Message);
		try throw "x" catch (e:cs.system.Exception) Sys.println("value as native " + e.Message + " " + name(e));
		try throw new cs.system.InvalidOperationException("io") catch (e:String) Sys.println("no") catch (e:haxe.Exception) Sys.println("second catch " + e.message);
		var a:Array<Int> = null;
		try a.push(1) catch (e:haxe.Exception) Sys.println("npe " + name(e.native));
		try {
			var d:Dynamic = {};
			d.foo();
		} catch (e:Dynamic) Sys.println("missing method: " + e);
		try {
			try throw new MyErr(7) catch (e:haxe.Exception) {
				Sys.println("inner");
				throw e;
			}
		} catch (e:MyErr) Sys.println("rethrown " + e.code);
		try {
			try throw "first" catch (e:String) throw e + "+second";
		} catch (e:String) Sys.println(e);
		try throw new NotImplementedException() catch (e:haxe.Exception) Sys.println(name(e) + ": " + e.message);
		try throw new ArgumentException("arg1", "bad arg") catch (e:ArgumentException) Sys.println(e.argument + " " + e.message);
		try throw new PosException("pos") catch (e:PosException) Sys.println(e.message + " / " + e.posInfos.methodName + " / " + e);
		var caught = haxe.Exception.caught("s");
		Sys.println(name(caught) + " " + caught.message);
		Sys.println(name(haxe.Exception.thrown("t")) + " " + name(haxe.Exception.thrown(new MyErr(8))) + " " + name(haxe.Exception.thrown(new cs.system.ArgumentException("a"))));
		var e = new haxe.Exception("plain");
		Sys.println(Std.string(e) + " " + (e.native == e) + " " + (e.unwrap() == e) + " " + (e.previous == null));
	}
}

--- method-closures @gencs
interface I {
	function hello(n:Int):String;
}
class Base implements I {
	public var tag:String;
	public function new(t) tag = t;
	public function hello(n:Int):String return tag + n;
	public function area(w:Float, h:Float):Float return w * h;
}
class Sub extends Base {
	override public function hello(n:Int):String return "sub" + n;
	function baseHello(n:Int) return super.hello(n);
	public function superHello():Int->String return baseHello;
}
class P {
	static function twice(x:Int):Int return x * 2;
	static function opt(a:Int, ?b:Int, c = 5):String return a + "," + b + "," + c;
	static function main() {
		var b = new Base("b");
		var f = b.hello;
		Sys.println(f(1));
		b.tag = "B";
		Sys.println(f(1));
		var g = twice;
		Sys.println(g(21));
		var i:I = new Sub("s");
		var h = i.hello;
		Sys.println(h(2));
		var bs:Base = new Sub("t");
		var hb = bs.hello;
		Sys.println(hb(3));
		Sys.println((cast bs : Sub).superHello()(4));
		var ar = b.area;
		Sys.println(ar(2, 3.5));
		var o = opt;
		Sys.println(o(1));
		Sys.println(o(1, 2));
		Sys.println(o(1, 2, 3));
		var dd:Dynamic = twice;
		Sys.println(dd(4));
		var d1:Dynamic = Reflect.field(b, "hello");
		Sys.println(d1(5));
		Sys.println(Reflect.callMethod(b, Reflect.field(b, "hello"), [7]));
		Sys.println(Reflect.callMethod(null, twice, [8]));
		var mx = Math.max;
		Sys.println(mx(1, 2));
		var pi = Std.parseInt;
		Sys.println(pi("42"));
		var up = "abc".toUpperCase;
		Sys.println(up());
		var sb = new StringBuf();
		var add = sb.add;
		add("z");
		Sys.println(sb.toString());
		Sys.println(Std.string(f) + " " + Std.string(g));
	}
}

class P {
	var name:String;
	var greet:Void->String;
	function new(n:String) {
		name = n;
		greet = () -> "hello " + name;
	}
	function suffixer():String->String {
		return function(s) return s + " from " + name;
	}
	static function main() {
		var k = 10;
		function add(x:Int):Int return x + k;
		Sys.println(add(5));
		var count = 0;
		var inc = function() count++;
		inc();
		inc();
		Sys.println(count);
		var s = "a";
		var get = () -> s;
		s = "b";
		Sys.println(get());
		function fact(n:Int):Int return n <= 1 ? 1 : n * fact(n - 1);
		Sys.println(fact(5));
		var outer = 1;
		function mk(y:Int) {
			return function(z:Int) return outer + y + z;
		}
		Sys.println(mk(2)(3));
		var f = 1.5;
		var addf = function(d:Float) f += d;
		addf(2.0);
		Sys.println(f);
		var p = new P("bob");
		Sys.println(p.suffixer()("hi"));
		Sys.println(p.greet());
		p.name = "ann";
		Sys.println(p.greet());

		var bump = () -> total += 2;
		var read = () -> total;
		bump();
		bump();
		Sys.println(read());

			return () -> start++;
		}

			var fe = () -> e + "!";

		}

--- closure-identity @gencs
class G<T> {
	var v:T;
	public function new(v:T) this.v = v;
	public function getter():Void->T return () -> v;
}
class P {
	static var sf:Int->Int = function(x) return x + 1;
	var cb:Void->Int;
	function new() {
		cb = () -> 1;
	}
	function inst():Void->P return () -> this;
	static function mk():Void->Int return () -> 42;
	static function mkCap(n:Int):Void->Int return () -> n;
	static function show(f:Dynamic) {
		Sys.println(Std.string(f) + " | " + Type.getClassName(Type.getClass(f)) + " | " + Type.typeof(f) + " | " + Reflect.isFunction(f));
	}
	static function main() {
		show(() -> 1);
		show(new P().inst());
		show(sf);
		show(new P().cb);
		show(new G("s").getter());
		var a = () -> 1; var b = () -> 2;
		show(a);
		show(b);
		Sys.println(mk() == mk());
		Sys.println(mkCap(1) == mkCap(1));
		Sys.println(sf(1));
		Sys.println(Reflect.isFunction(1));
		try haxe.Serializer.run(a) catch (e:String) Sys.println(e);
	}
}

# The Serializer corpus (docs/superpowers/plans/2026-10-23-dotnet-closures-enums-std/serial/P.hx,
# whose corpus_typed entries serial-corpus-typed checks): gencs's output, with
# -D net-ver=40 as the server app builds, without the entries that depend on the time zone (ZONED), which
# serial-dates checks against gencs on this machine.
--- serial-corpus @serial + -D net-ver=40
// The haxe.Serializer corpus (milestone 3b): `gen <file>` serializes every value twice (plain, and
// with useCache + useEnumIndex) into name<TAB>serialized lines and appends the hand-written INPUTS;
// `rt <in> <file>` unserializes each line of <in> and serializes the value again. Both write the
// lines to <file> and print them to stdout through Sorted, which writes the entries of a StringMap or
// ObjectMap with two or more keys in a fixed order: hxcs takes their order from per-process hash
// codes (String.GetHashCode is randomized on .NET Core). Everything else prints as written.
// The entries in ZONED depend on the machine's time zone: `gen` writes only them under
// -D corpus_dates and everything else without it, so the rest can keep a literal expectation.
import haxe.Serializer;
import haxe.Unserializer;

enum E {
	A;
	B(i:Int, s:String);
	C(e:E);
	D(?x:Int, f:Float);
}

class Pt {
	public var x:Int;
	public var y:Float;
	public var tag:String;
	public var next:Pt;

	public function new(x:Int, y:Float) {
		this.x = x;
		this.y = y;
	}
}

class Sub extends Pt {
	public var ok:Bool;
	public var n:Null<Int>;
	public var any:Dynamic;
	public static var ignored = 5;

	public function new() {
		super(1, 2);
	}
}

class Holder {
	public var n:Null<Int>;
	public var i:Int;
	public var b:Bool;
	public var f:Float;
	public var s:String;

	public function new() {}
}

class Typed {
	public var a:Array<Int>;
	public var f:Array<Float>;
	public var m:Map<String, Int>;
	public var l:List<String>;
	public var s:Array<String>;

	public function new() {}
}

class Custom {
	public var v:Int = 3;

	public function new() {}

	@:keep public function hxSerialize(s:Serializer) {
		s.serialize(v);
		s.serialize("c");
	}

	@:keep public function hxUnserialize(u:Unserializer) {
		v = u.unserialize();
		u.unserialize();
	}
}

// htmlparser's HtmlNode shape, which the server app uses: the serializer arrives through an anonymous type.
class Structural {
	public var t:String = "t";

	public function new() {}

	@:keep public function hxSerialize(s:{function serialize(d:Dynamic):Void;}) {
		s.serialize(t);
	}

	@:keep public function hxUnserialize(s:{function unserialize():Dynamic;}) {
		t = s.unserialize();
	}
}

class Sorted extends Serializer {
	override public function serialize(v:Dynamic) {
		var c = Type.getClass(v);
		var name = c == null ? "" : Type.getClassName(c);
		if (name == "haxe.ds.StringMap" && count((v : haxe.ds.StringMap<Dynamic>).keys()) > 1) {
			var m:haxe.ds.StringMap<Dynamic> = v;
			buf.add("b");
			for (k in sort([for (k in m.keys()) k]).keys) {
				serializeString(k);
				serialize(m.get(k));
			}
			buf.add("h");
		} else if (name == "haxe.ds.ObjectMap" && count((v : haxe.ds.ObjectMap<Dynamic, Dynamic>).keys()) > 1) {
			var m:haxe.ds.ObjectMap<Dynamic, Dynamic> = v;
			var keys = [for (k in m.keys()) k];
			var r = sort([for (k in keys) Serializer.run(k)]);
			buf.add("M");
			for (i in r.order) {
				serialize(keys[i]);
				serialize(m.get(keys[i]));
			}
			buf.add("h");
		} else
			super.serialize(v);
	}

	static function count(it:Iterator<Dynamic>):Int {
		var n = 0;
		for (_ in it)
			n++;
		return n;
	}

	// Insertion sort, so the corpus needs no closures for it.
	static function sort(a:Array<String>):{keys:Array<String>, order:Array<Int>} {
		var keys = a.copy(), order = [for (i in 0...a.length) i];
		for (i in 1...keys.length) {
			var j = i;
			while (j > 0 && keys[j - 1] > keys[j]) {
				var t = keys[j];
				keys[j] = keys[j - 1];
				keys[j - 1] = t;
				var o = order[j];
				order[j] = order[j - 1];
				order[j - 1] = o;
				j--;
			}
		}
		return {keys: keys, order: order};
	}
}

class P {
	static function values():Array<{name:String, v:Dynamic}> {
		var bytes = haxe.io.Bytes.alloc(10);
		for (i in 0...10)
			bytes.set(i, i * 29);
		var sm1 = new haxe.ds.StringMap<Dynamic>();
		sm1.set("a", 1);
		var sm3 = new haxe.ds.StringMap<Dynamic>();
		sm3.set("a", 1);
		sm3.set("b", "two");
		sm3.set("c", null);
		var im = new haxe.ds.IntMap<Dynamic>();
		im.set(1, "x");
		im.set(7, "y");
		im.set(-3, 2.5);
		im.set(100, null);
		var om1 = new haxe.ds.ObjectMap<Dynamic, Dynamic>();
		om1.set(new Pt(1, 2), 5);

	// Entries gen leaves out because hxc gets them wrong: none since plan 3c, which restored classArray.
	static var LATER:Array<String> = [];

	static function wanted(name:String):Bool {
		if (LATER.indexOf(name) >= 0)
			return false;
		#if corpus_dates
		return ZONED.indexOf(name) >= 0;
		#else
		return ZONED.indexOf(name) < 0;
		#end
	}

	static function serialize(name:String, v:Dynamic, sorted:Bool):String {
		var s = sorted ? new Sorted() : new Serializer();
		if (name.indexOf("+cache+idx") >= 0) {
			s.useCache = true;
			s.useEnumIndex = true;
		}
		s.serialize(v);
		return s.toString();
	}

	static function error(ex:Dynamic):String {
		var s = if (Std.isOfType(ex, cs.system.Exception)) {
			var ce:cs.system.Exception = ex;
			Type.getClassName(Type.getClass(ex)) + ": " + ce.Message;
		} else Std.string(ex);
		return "EXC " + StringTools.replace(StringTools.replace(s, "\r", ""), "\n", "\\n");
	}

	static var raw = new StringBuf();
	static var shown = new StringBuf();

	static function add(name:String, v:Dynamic) {
		raw.add(name + "	" + (try serialize(name, v, false) catch (ex:Dynamic) error(ex)) + "
");
		shown.add(name + "	" + (try serialize(name, v, true) catch (ex:Dynamic) error(ex)) + "
");
	}

	static function main() {
		var args = Sys.args();
		if (args[0] == "gen") {
			for (e in values()) {
				if (!wanted(e.name))
					continue;
				add(e.name, e.v);
				add(e.name + "+cache+idx", e.v);
			}
			for (i in INPUTS) {
				if (!wanted(i[0]))
					continue;
				raw.add(i[0] + "\t" + i[1] + "\n");
				shown.add(i[0] + "\t" + i[1] + "\n");
			}
			cs.system.io.File.WriteAllText(args[1], raw.toString());
		} else if (args[0] == "rt") {
			for (line in cs.system.io.File.ReadAllText(args[1]).split("\n")) {
				if (line == "")
					continue;
				var i = line.indexOf("\t");
				var name = line.substr(0, i), ser = line.substr(i + 1);
				if (StringTools.startsWith(ser, "EXC ")) {
					raw.add(line + "\n");
					shown.add(line + "\n");
					continue;
				}
				try {
					add(name, new Unserializer(ser).unserialize());
				} catch (ex:Dynamic) {
					raw.add(name + "\t" + error(ex) + "\n");
					shown.add(name + "\t" + error(ex) + "\n");
				}
			}
			cs.system.io.File.WriteAllText(args[2], raw.toString());
		}
		Sys.print(shown.toString());
	}
}

--- serial-dates @serial + -D net-ver=40 -D corpus_dates
// The haxe.Serializer corpus (milestone 3b): `gen <file>` serializes every value twice (plain, and
// with useCache + useEnumIndex) into name<TAB>serialized lines and appends the hand-written INPUTS;
// `rt <in> <file>` unserializes each line of <in> and serializes the value again. Both write the
// lines to <file> and print them to stdout through Sorted, which writes the entries of a StringMap or
// ObjectMap with two or more keys in a fixed order: hxcs takes their order from per-process hash
// codes (String.GetHashCode is randomized on .NET Core). Everything else prints as written.
// The entries in ZONED depend on the machine's time zone: `gen` writes only them under
// -D corpus_dates and everything else without it, so the rest can keep a literal expectation.
import haxe.Serializer;
import haxe.Unserializer;

enum E {
	A;
	B(i:Int, s:String);
	C(e:E);
	D(?x:Int, f:Float);
}

class Pt {
	public var x:Int;
	public var y:Float;
	public var tag:String;
	public var next:Pt;

	public function new(x:Int, y:Float) {
		this.x = x;
		this.y = y;
	}
}

class Sub extends Pt {
	public var ok:Bool;
	public var n:Null<Int>;
	public var any:Dynamic;
	public static var ignored = 5;

	public function new() {
		super(1, 2);
	}
}

class Holder {
	public var n:Null<Int>;
	public var i:Int;
	public var b:Bool;
	public var f:Float;
	public var s:String;

	public function new() {}
}

class Typed {
	public var a:Array<Int>;
	public var f:Array<Float>;
	public var m:Map<String, Int>;
	public var l:List<String>;
	public var s:Array<String>;

	public function new() {}
}

class Custom {
	public var v:Int = 3;

	public function new() {}

	@:keep public function hxSerialize(s:Serializer) {
		s.serialize(v);
		s.serialize("c");
	}

	@:keep public function hxUnserialize(u:Unserializer) {
		v = u.unserialize();
		u.unserialize();
	}
}

// htmlparser's HtmlNode shape, which the server app uses: the serializer arrives through an anonymous type.
class Structural {
	public var t:String = "t";

	public function new() {}

	@:keep public function hxSerialize(s:{function serialize(d:Dynamic):Void;}) {
		s.serialize(t);
	}

	@:keep public function hxUnserialize(s:{function unserialize():Dynamic;}) {
		t = s.unserialize();
	}
}

class Sorted extends Serializer {
	override public function serialize(v:Dynamic) {
		var c = Type.getClass(v);
		var name = c == null ? "" : Type.getClassName(c);
		if (name == "haxe.ds.StringMap" && count((v : haxe.ds.StringMap<Dynamic>).keys()) > 1) {
			var m:haxe.ds.StringMap<Dynamic> = v;
			buf.add("b");
			for (k in sort([for (k in m.keys()) k]).keys) {
				serializeString(k);
				serialize(m.get(k));
			}
			buf.add("h");
		} else if (name == "haxe.ds.ObjectMap" && count((v : haxe.ds.ObjectMap<Dynamic, Dynamic>).keys()) > 1) {
			var m:haxe.ds.ObjectMap<Dynamic, Dynamic> = v;
			var keys = [for (k in m.keys()) k];
			var r = sort([for (k in keys) Serializer.run(k)]);
			buf.add("M");
			for (i in r.order) {
				serialize(keys[i]);
				serialize(m.get(keys[i]));
			}
			buf.add("h");
		} else
			super.serialize(v);
	}

	static function count(it:Iterator<Dynamic>):Int {
		var n = 0;
		for (_ in it)
			n++;
		return n;
	}

	// Insertion sort, so the corpus needs no closures for it.
	static function sort(a:Array<String>):{keys:Array<String>, order:Array<Int>} {
		var keys = a.copy(), order = [for (i in 0...a.length) i];
		for (i in 1...keys.length) {
			var j = i;
			while (j > 0 && keys[j - 1] > keys[j]) {
				var t = keys[j];
				keys[j] = keys[j - 1];
				keys[j - 1] = t;
				var o = order[j];
				order[j] = order[j - 1];
				order[j - 1] = o;
				j--;
			}
		}
		return {keys: keys, order: order};
	}
}

	// Entries gen leaves out because hxc gets them wrong: none since plan 3c, which restored classArray.
	static var LATER:Array<String> = [];

	static function wanted(name:String):Bool {
		if (LATER.indexOf(name) >= 0)
			return false;
		#if corpus_dates
		return ZONED.indexOf(name) >= 0;
		#else
		return ZONED.indexOf(name) < 0;
		#end
	}

	static function serialize(name:String, v:Dynamic, sorted:Bool):String {
		var s = sorted ? new Sorted() : new Serializer();
		if (name.indexOf("+cache+idx") >= 0) {
			s.useCache = true;
			s.useEnumIndex = true;
		}
		s.serialize(v);
		return s.toString();
	}

	static function error(ex:Dynamic):String {
		var s = if (Std.isOfType(ex, cs.system.Exception)) {
			var ce:cs.system.Exception = ex;
			Type.getClassName(Type.getClass(ex)) + ": " + ce.Message;
		} else Std.string(ex);
		return "EXC " + StringTools.replace(StringTools.replace(s, "\r", ""), "\n", "\\n");
	}

	static var raw = new StringBuf();
	static var shown = new StringBuf();

	static function add(name:String, v:Dynamic) {
		raw.add(name + "	" + (try serialize(name, v, false) catch (ex:Dynamic) error(ex)) + "
");
		shown.add(name + "	" + (try serialize(name, v, true) catch (ex:Dynamic) error(ex)) + "
");
	}

	static function main() {
		var args = Sys.args();
		if (args[0] == "gen") {
			for (e in values()) {
				if (!wanted(e.name))
					continue;
				add(e.name, e.v);
				add(e.name + "+cache+idx", e.v);
			}
			for (i in INPUTS) {
				if (!wanted(i[0]))
					continue;
				raw.add(i[0] + "\t" + i[1] + "\n");
				shown.add(i[0] + "\t" + i[1] + "\n");
			}
			cs.system.io.File.WriteAllText(args[1], raw.toString());
		} else if (args[0] == "rt") {
			for (line in cs.system.io.File.ReadAllText(args[1]).split("\n")) {
				if (line == "")
					continue;
				var i = line.indexOf("\t");
				var name = line.substr(0, i), ser = line.substr(i + 1);
				if (StringTools.startsWith(ser, "EXC ")) {
					raw.add(line + "\n");
					shown.add(line + "\n");
					continue;
				}
				try {
					add(name, new Unserializer(ser).unserialize());
				} catch (ex:Dynamic) {
					raw.add(name + "\t" + error(ex) + "\n");
					shown.add(name + "\t" + error(ex) + "\n");
				}
			}
			cs.system.io.File.WriteAllText(args[2], raw.toString());
		}
		Sys.print(shown.toString());
	}
}

# The corpus's corpus_typed entries (plan 3c): maps and lists whose type parameters are not Dynamic, a
# class with typed fields, generic classes by name, and the in.t* inputs that cast into typed fields
# (casts notes §5, §6.10), against gencs; gencs's output is the expectation.
--- serial-corpus-typed @serial + -D net-ver=40 -D corpus_typed
// The haxe.Serializer corpus (milestone 3b): `gen <file>` serializes every value twice (plain, and
// with useCache + useEnumIndex) into name<TAB>serialized lines and appends the hand-written INPUTS;
// `rt <in> <file>` unserializes each line of <in> and serializes the value again. Both write the
// lines to <file> and print them to stdout through Sorted, which writes the entries of a StringMap or
// ObjectMap with two or more keys in a fixed order: hxcs takes their order from per-process hash
// codes (String.GetHashCode is randomized on .NET Core). Everything else prints as written.
// The entries in ZONED depend on the machine's time zone: `gen` writes only them under
// -D corpus_dates and everything else without it, so the rest can keep a literal expectation.
import haxe.Serializer;
import haxe.Unserializer;

	D(?x:Int, f:Float);
}

// htmlparser's HtmlNode shape, which the server app uses: the serializer arrives through an anonymous type.
class Structural {
	public var t:String = "t";

	public function new() {}

	@:keep public function hxSerialize(s:{function serialize(d:Dynamic):Void;}) {
		s.serialize(t);
	}

	@:keep public function hxUnserialize(s:{function unserialize():Dynamic;}) {
		t = s.unserialize();
	}
}

class Sorted extends Serializer {
	override public function serialize(v:Dynamic) {
		var c = Type.getClass(v);
		var name = c == null ? "" : Type.getClassName(c);
		if (name == "haxe.ds.StringMap" && count((v : haxe.ds.StringMap<Dynamic>).keys()) > 1) {
			var m:haxe.ds.StringMap<Dynamic> = v;
			buf.add("b");
			for (k in sort([for (k in m.keys()) k]).keys) {
				serializeString(k);
				serialize(m.get(k));
			}
			buf.add("h");
		} else if (name == "haxe.ds.ObjectMap" && count((v : haxe.ds.ObjectMap<Dynamic, Dynamic>).keys()) > 1) {
			var m:haxe.ds.ObjectMap<Dynamic, Dynamic> = v;
			var keys = [for (k in m.keys()) k];
			var r = sort([for (k in keys) Serializer.run(k)]);
			buf.add("M");
			for (i in r.order) {
				serialize(keys[i]);
				serialize(m.get(keys[i]));
			}
			buf.add("h");
		} else
			super.serialize(v);
	}

	static function count(it:Iterator<Dynamic>):Int {
		var n = 0;
		for (_ in it)
			n++;
		return n;
	}

	// Insertion sort, so the corpus needs no closures for it.
	static function sort(a:Array<String>):{keys:Array<String>, order:Array<Int>} {
		var keys = a.copy(), order = [for (i in 0...a.length) i];
		for (i in 1...keys.length) {
			var j = i;
			while (j > 0 && keys[j - 1] > keys[j]) {
				var t = keys[j];
				keys[j] = keys[j - 1];
				keys[j - 1] = t;
				var o = order[j];
				order[j] = order[j - 1];
				order[j - 1] = o;
				j--;
			}
		}
		return {keys: keys, order: order};
	}
}

	// Entries gen leaves out because hxc gets them wrong: none since plan 3c, which restored classArray.
	static var LATER:Array<String> = [];

	static function wanted(name:String):Bool {
		if (LATER.indexOf(name) >= 0)
			return false;
		#if corpus_dates
		return ZONED.indexOf(name) >= 0;
		#else
		return ZONED.indexOf(name) < 0;
		#end
	}

	static function serialize(name:String, v:Dynamic, sorted:Bool):String {
		var s = sorted ? new Sorted() : new Serializer();
		if (name.indexOf("+cache+idx") >= 0) {
			s.useCache = true;
			s.useEnumIndex = true;
		}
		s.serialize(v);
		return s.toString();
	}

	static function error(ex:Dynamic):String {
		var s = if (Std.isOfType(ex, cs.system.Exception)) {
			var ce:cs.system.Exception = ex;
			Type.getClassName(Type.getClass(ex)) + ": " + ce.Message;
		} else Std.string(ex);
		return "EXC " + StringTools.replace(StringTools.replace(s, "\r", ""), "\n", "\\n");
	}

	static var raw = new StringBuf();
	static var shown = new StringBuf();

	static function add(name:String, v:Dynamic) {
		raw.add(name + "	" + (try serialize(name, v, false) catch (ex:Dynamic) error(ex)) + "
");
		shown.add(name + "	" + (try serialize(name, v, true) catch (ex:Dynamic) error(ex)) + "
");
	}

	static function main() {
		var args = Sys.args();
		if (args[0] == "gen") {
			for (e in values()) {
				if (!wanted(e.name))
					continue;
				add(e.name, e.v);
				add(e.name + "+cache+idx", e.v);
			}
			for (i in INPUTS) {
				if (!wanted(i[0]))
					continue;
				raw.add(i[0] + "\t" + i[1] + "\n");
				shown.add(i[0] + "\t" + i[1] + "\n");
			}
			cs.system.io.File.WriteAllText(args[1], raw.toString());
		} else if (args[0] == "rt") {
			for (line in cs.system.io.File.ReadAllText(args[1]).split("\n")) {
				if (line == "")
					continue;
				var i = line.indexOf("\t");
				var name = line.substr(0, i), ser = line.substr(i + 1);
				if (StringTools.startsWith(ser, "EXC ")) {
					raw.add(line + "\n");
					shown.add(line + "\n");
					continue;
				}
				try {
					add(name, new Unserializer(ser).unserialize());
				} catch (ex:Dynamic) {
					raw.add(name + "\t" + error(ex) + "\n");
					shown.add(name + "\t" + error(ex) + "\n");
				}
			}
			cs.system.io.File.WriteAllText(args[2], raw.toString());
		}
		Sys.print(shown.toString());
	}
}

# A Haxe interface's variables and dynamic methods are no members of the CLR interface (gencs's
# InterfaceVarsDeleteModf): through the interface they are Runtime.getField/setField/callField, as
# for a Dynamic, through a parameter, a field, a local, a type parameter and a closure; a property's
# accessors are the interface's methods, which Type.getInstanceFields lists.
--- interface-variables @gencs
interface I {
	var x:Int;
	var s:String;
	var p(get, set):Float;
	var r(default, null):String;
	var n:Null<Int>;
	var cb:Int->Int;
	dynamic function d(a:Int):Int;
	function m():Int;
}
interface J extends I {
	var y:Float;
	var w(default, set):Int;
}
interface G<T> {
	var v:T;
}
class C implements J implements G<String> {
	public var x:Int = 3;
	public var s:String = "s";
	public var p(get, set):Float;
	public var r(default, null):String = "r";
	public var n:Null<Int>;
	public var cb:Int->Int;
	public var y:Float = 0.5;
	public var w(default, set):Int = 0;
	public var v:String = "v";
	var pv = 1.5;
	public function new() {
		cb = a -> a * 3;
	}
	function get_p() return pv;
	function set_p(v:Float) return pv = v;
	function set_w(v:Int) return w = v + 100;
	public dynamic function d(a:Int):Int return a - 1;
	public function m() return x + 1;
}
class Holder {
	public var i:I;
	public function new(i:I) this.i = i;
}
class P {
	static function show(i:I) {
		Sys.println(i.x + " " + i.s + " " + i.p + " " + i.r + " " + i.n + " " + i.m());
	}
	static function twice<T:J>(t:T):Float {
		t.y *= 2;
		return t.y;
	}
	static function main() {
		var j:J = new C();
		var i:I = j;
		show(i);
		i.x = 10;
		i.x += 5;
		i.x++;
		Sys.println(++i.x);
		i.s = "t";
		i.s += "u";
		i.p = 2.5;
		i.n = 4;
		Sys.println(i.n + 1);
		show(i);
		var h = new Holder(new C());
		h.i.x = 8;
		h.i.p = 1.25;
		show(h.i);
		Sys.println(i.cb(2) + " " + i.d(10));
		var dd = i.d;
		Sys.println(dd(20));
		i.d = a -> a * a;
		Sys.println(i.d(7) + " " + dd(7));
		j.y += 1.25;
		j.w = 5;
		Sys.println(j.y + " " + j.w + " " + twice(j));
		var c:C = cast j;
		var g:G<String> = c;
		g.v += "!";
		Sys.println(g.v + " " + g.v.length);
		var read = () -> i.x * 2;
		Sys.println(read());
		Sys.println(Reflect.field(i, "x") + " " + Reflect.fields(i).length);
		var none:I = null;
		Sys.println(none == null);
		Sys.println(Type.getInstanceFields(I));
		Sys.println(Type.getInstanceFields(J));
		Sys.println(Type.getInstanceFields(G));
	}
}

# A switch on a Dynamic with enum patterns: gencs reads the index with Type.enumIndex(d), which casts
# to haxe.lang.Enum (InvalidCastException for a String), and an argument as ((E)d as E_C).arg, so a
# value of another enum matches by index alone.
--- dynamic-enum-switch @gencs + -dce full
enum E {
	A;
	B(x:Int);
	C(s:String, n:Float);
}
enum F {
	FA;
	FB(e:E);
}
class P {
	static function f(d:Dynamic):String {
		return switch (d) {
			case A: "a";
			case B(x): "b" + (x + 1);
			case C(s, n): "c" + s + n;
			case _: "other";
		}
	}
	static function g(d:Dynamic):String {
		return switch (d) {
			case FB(B(x)) if (x > 1): "fbb" + x;
			case FB(e): "fb" + Type.enumConstructor(e);
			case FA: "fa";

# An interface method implemented with the same parameter types and another return type (a subclass,
# Int for Float or Dynamic, through a superclass's method too): gencs's FixOverrides adds a private
# explicit implementation, `global::<interface>.<name>`, which calls the method and casts the result,
# the last one made first in the class.
--- interface-implementations-with-other-types @gencs
interface IDS {
	function n():Int;
}
class DS implements IDS {
	public function new() {}
	public function n() return 1;
}
interface I {
	var record(get, never):IDS;
	function copy(a:Array<Int>):IDS;
	function count():Float;
	function any():Dynamic;
	function same(x:Int):Int;
}

	function get(a:T):Iterable<T>;
}
interface IG2<A, B> {
	function pair(a:A, b:B):Dynamic;
}
class Base {
	public function new() {}
	public function copy(a:Array<Int>) return new DS();
}
class C extends Base implements I implements IG<String> implements IG2<String, Int> {
	public var record(get, never):IDS;
	function get_record() return new DS();
	public function count():Int return 7;
	public function any():Int return 8;
	public function same(x:Int) return x + 1;

	override public function count():Int return 9;

--- serial-null-type-arguments @serial
// Arrays whose element type is Null<Int>, Null<Float> or Null<Bool> through haxe.Serializer, read
// back by the other build (gencs erases those type arguments to object; hxc keeps haxe.lang.Null<T>).
import haxe.Serializer;
import haxe.Unserializer;

class P {
	static function values():Array<{name:String, v:Dynamic}> {
		var ints:Array<Null<Int>> = [1, null, 2];
		var holes:Array<Null<Int>> = [];
		holes[2] = 5;
		var floats:Array<Null<Float>> = [1.5, null, 3];
		var bools:Array<Null<Bool>> = [true, null, false];
		var nested:Array<Array<Null<Int>>> = [ints, [null]];
		return [
			{name: "ints", v: ints}, {name: "holes", v: holes}, {name: "floats", v: floats},
			{name: "bools", v: bools}, {name: "nested", v: nested}, {name: "anon", v: {a: ints}},
		];
	}

	static function serialize(v:Dynamic):String {
		var s = new Serializer();
		s.serialize(v);
		return s.toString();
	}

	static function main() {
		var args = Sys.args();
		var out = new StringBuf();
		if (args[0] == "gen") {
			for (e in values()) {
				out.add(e.name + "\t" + serialize(e.v) + "\n");
			}
			cs.system.io.File.WriteAllText(args[1], out.toString());
		} else if (args[0] == "rt") {
			for (line in cs.system.io.File.ReadAllText(args[1]).split("\n")) {
				if (line == "")
					continue;
				var i = line.indexOf("\t");
				out.add(line.substr(0, i) + "\t" + serialize(Unserializer.run(line.substr(i + 1))) + "\n");
			}
			cs.system.io.File.WriteAllText(args[2], out.toString());
		}
		Sys.print(out.toString());
	}
}

// haxeui's Variant: an abstract over an enum, switched on with the enum's patterns.
enum VT {
	VI(s:Int);
	VS(s:String);
	VN;
}

abstract V(VT) from VT {
	public function new(x) this = x;

	public var isNumber(get, never):Bool;

	function get_isNumber():Bool {
		return switch (this) {
			case VI(_): true;
			case _: false;
		}
	}
}

class P {
	static function toDyn(v:V):Dynamic {
		var d:Dynamic = v;
		if (v != null) {
			switch (v) {
				case VT.VI(y): d = y;
				case VT.VS(y): d = y;
				case VT.VN: d = "none";
			}
		}
		return d;
	}

	static function name(w:V):String {
		return switch (w) {
			case VI(n) if (n > 9): "big";
			case VI(_): "int";
			case VS(s): "str " + s;
			case VN: "none";
		}
	}

	static function main() {
		Sys.println(toDyn(VI(3)));
		Sys.println(toDyn(VS("a")));
		Sys.println(toDyn(VN));
		Sys.println(toDyn(null));
		Sys.println(new V(VI(1)).isNumber + " " + new V(VN).isNumber);
		for (v in [VI(10), VI(2), VS("x"), VN])
			Sys.println(name(v));
		var f = (v:V) -> switch (v) {
			case VS(s): s.length;
			case _: -1;
		};
		Sys.println(f(VS("abc")) + f(VN));
	}
}

--- dynamic-value-switch @gencs
// haxeui's Canvas: a switch on a Dynamic with String and Int patterns.
class P {
	static function sw(item:Dynamic) {
		switch (item.id) {
			case "clear": Sys.println("clear");
			case "moveTo" | "move-to": Sys.println("move");
			default: Sys.println("other " + item.id);
		}
	}

	static function num(d:Dynamic):String {
		return switch (d) {
			case 1: "one";
			case 2 | 3: "few";
			case 10 if (Std.isOfType(d, Int)): "ten";
			case _: "many";
		}
	}

	static function mixed(d:Dynamic):Int {
		var r = 0;
		switch (d) {
			case "a": r = 1;
			case 2: r = 2;
		}
		return r;
	}

	static var calls = 0;

	static function subject(d:Dynamic):Dynamic {
		calls++;
		return d;
	}

	static function main() {
		sw({id: "clear"});
		sw({id: "move-to"});
		sw({id: "moveTo"});
		sw({id: 3});
		sw({id: null});
		sw({});
		for (d in ([1, 2, 3, 10, 10.0, 11, "1", null, 2.0] : Array<Dynamic>))
			Sys.println(num(d));
		Sys.println(mixed("a") + mixed(2) + mixed("b") + mixed(null));
		var s = switch (subject("x")) {
			case "y": 1;
			case "z": 2;
			case _: 3;
		}
		Sys.println(s + " " + calls);
	}
}

--- try-in-captured-initializer @gencs
// The desktop app's Transfer: a try in the initializer of a captured variable that is written.
class P {
	static function tr(f:Void->Int, fail:String->Void):Void->Int {
		var copy = try f() catch (e:Dynamic) { fail(Std.string(e)); return null; };
		var g = () -> copy++;
		return () -> copy + g();
	}

	static function tr2(f:Void->String):String {
		var s = try f() catch (e:String) "caught " + e;
		var add = (x:String) -> s += x;
		add("!");
		return s;
	}

	static function main() {
		Sys.println(tr(() -> 4, s -> Sys.println("fail " + s))());
		Sys.println(tr(() -> throw "x", s -> Sys.println("fail " + s)) == null);
		Sys.println(tr2(() -> "ok"));
		Sys.println(tr2(() -> throw "bad"));
		var a = [() -> 1];
		var r = [for (x in a) () -> x()];
		Sys.println(r[0]());
		var n = 0;
		var h = () -> n++;
		var m = [while (n < 3) h()];
		Sys.println(m);
	}
}

// Generic methods whose type argument the typer infers as Null<Int>, Null<Float> or Null<Bool>
// (the server app's Lambda calls over Array<Null<Float>>): the type argument stays Null<T>, so a null stays null.
class Box<T> {
	public var v:T;

	public function new(v:T) this.v = v;

	public function map<U>(f:T->U):Box<U> return new Box(f(v));
}

class P {
	static function id<T>(x:T):T return x;

	static function isNull<T>(x:T):Bool return x == null;

	static function first<T>(a:Array<T>):T return a[0];

	static function pair<A, B>(a:A, b:B):String return a + "/" + b;

	static function opt<T>(?x:T):String return "" + x;

	static function t(f:Void->Dynamic) {
		try Sys.println(f()) catch (e:Dynamic) Sys.println("EXC " + Type.getClassName(Type.getClass(e)));
	}

	static function main() {
		var g:Array<Null<Int>> = [1, null, 3];
		t(() -> Lambda.exists(g, v -> v == null));
		t(() -> Lambda.count(g, v -> v == null));
		t(() -> Lambda.count(g));
		t(() -> Lambda.fold(g, (v, acc:String) -> acc + "," + v, ""));
		t(() -> Lambda.find(g, v -> v == null) == null);
		t(() -> Lambda.find(g, v -> v != null && v > 1));
		t(() -> Lambda.has(g, null));
		t(() -> Lambda.has(g, 3));
		t(() -> Lambda.has(g, 4));
		t(() -> Lambda.array(g).join(","));
		t(() -> Lambda.indexOf(g, null));
		t(() -> Lambda.filter(g, v -> v == null).length);

		t(() -> Lambda.fold(gf, (v, acc:String) -> acc + "," + v, ""));
		t(() -> Lambda.find(gf, v -> v == null) == null);
		t(() -> Lambda.has(gf, null));
		var gb:Array<Null<Bool>> = [null, false];
		t(() -> Lambda.count(gb, v -> v == null));
		t(() -> Lambda.has(gb, false));

		var nn:Null<Int> = null, n5:Null<Int> = 5;
		t(() -> id(nn) == null);
		t(() -> id(n5) + 1);
		t(() -> isNull(nn) + " " + isNull(n5));
		var nf:Null<Float> = null;
		t(() -> id(nf) == null);
		t(() -> isNull(nf));
		t(() -> first(g) + 1);
		t(() -> first([null, 2]) == null);
		t(() -> pair(nn, n5));
		t(() -> pair(nf, 1));
		var tb:Null<Bool> = true, nb:Null<Bool> = null;
		t(() -> pair(tb, nb) + " " + Std.string(id(tb)) + " " + id(tb));
		t(() -> opt(nn) + " " + opt(n5) + " " + opt());
		t(() -> new Box(nn).map(v -> v == null).v);
		t(() -> new Box(n5).map(v -> v == null ? null : v + 1).v);
		// Typed calls with plain values keep Int.
		t(() -> id(4) + id(1.5));
		t(() -> isNull("s") + " " + isNull((null:String)));
		t(() -> (id((null:Null<Int>)) : Null<Int>) == null);
		t(() -> id((7:Int)));
		t(() -> Lambda.count([1, 2, 3], v -> v > 1));
		t(() -> Lambda.fold([1, 2], (v, acc:Int) -> acc + v, 0));
	}

--- null-return-type-inference @gencs
// gencs binds a type parameter met inside a declared Null<T> (a Null<T> return, binding first, or a
// Null<T> or optional argument) to the basic type: Lambda.find<int>, wrap<int>(nn.@value). A null
// Null<Int> argument then becomes 0, an hxcs bug this keeps. A plain T binds object, as before.
class P {
	static function wrap<T>(x:T):Null<T> return x;

	static function idt<T>(x:T):T return x;

	static function p2<T>(a:Null<T>, b:T):String return a + "|" + b;

	static function p3<T>(b:T, a:Null<T>):String return a + "|" + b;

	static function opt<T>(x:Int, ?y:T):String return x + ":" + y;

	static function retFn<T>(x:T):Void->Null<T> return () -> x;

	static function nullArr<T>(a:Array<Null<T>>):T return a[0];

	static function two<A, B>(a:A, b:B):Null<B> return b;

	static function t(f:Void->Dynamic) {
		try Sys.println(f()) catch (e:Dynamic) Sys.println("EXC " + Type.getClassName(Type.getClass(e)));
	}

	static function main() {
		var g:Array<Null<Int>> = [1, null, 3];
		var gf:Array<Null<Float>> = [null, 2.5];
		t(() -> Lambda.find(g, v -> v != 1));
		t(() -> Lambda.find(g, v -> v != 1) == null);
		t(() -> Lambda.find(g, v -> v == 3));
		t(() -> Lambda.find(g, v -> v == 9));
		t(() -> Lambda.find(g, v -> v == 9) == null);
		t(() -> Lambda.find(gf, v -> true));
		t(() -> Lambda.find(gf, v -> v == null) == null);
		t(() -> Lambda.find(gf, v -> v != null) * 2);
		var d:Dynamic = Lambda.find(g, v -> v != 1);
		t(() -> Type.typeof(d));
		var nn:Null<Int> = null, n5:Null<Int> = 5;
		t(() -> wrap(nn));
		t(() -> wrap(nn) == null);
		t(() -> wrap(n5) + 1);
		t(() -> wrap(4));
		t(() -> idt(nn) == null);
		t(() -> p2(nn, nn) + " " + p3(nn, nn) + " " + p2(nn, 3) + " " + p3(4, nn));
		t(() -> opt(1, nn) + " " + opt(2, n5) + " " + opt(3));
		t(() -> retFn(nn)());
		t(() -> nullArr(g));
		t(() -> two(nn, nn));
		t(() -> haxe.Serializer.run(Lambda.find(g, v -> v != 1)));
		t(() -> haxe.Serializer.run(Lambda.find(g, v -> v == 9)));
		t(() -> haxe.Serializer.run(wrap(nn)));
	}
}

--- null-type-parameter-binding @gencs
// gencs binds a generic method's type parameters by Haxe's unification of each argument's and the
// return's applied type with the declared one: a Null<T> meeting a Null<Int> binds Int where the
// applied type is on the left (an argument, the return), Null<Int> (gencs's object) inside a function
// argument's own arguments, and one Null level per side inside a type argument (retOpt<object>). A
// local generic function unifies its whole function type, so its arguments flip: le<int>, lz<object>.
import haxe.ds.Option;

class B<T> {
	public var v:T;

	public function new(v:T) this.v = v;

	public function wrapC(x:T):Null<T> return x;

	public function mapN<U>(f:T->U):Null<U> return f(v);

	public function pick<U>(x:U, y:Null<U>):String return x + "|" + y + "|" + (y == null);
}

class K<T> {
	public function new() {}

	public function each<U>(f:Null<U>->Void, x:U):Void f(x);
}

class P {
	static function t(f:Void->Dynamic) {
		try Sys.println(f()) catch (e:Dynamic) Sys.println("EXC " + Type.getClassName(Type.getClass(e)));
	}

	static function deep<T>(a:Array<Array<Null<T>>>):T return a[0][0];

	static function cbn<T>(f:Null<T>->Bool, x:T):String return f(x) + "|" + x;

	static function cbf<T>(f:T->Bool, x:Null<T>):String return f(x) + "|" + x;

	static function cbr<T>(f:Void->Null<T>):T return f();

	static function cbn4<T>(f:Null<T>->Void, x:T):Void f(x);

	static function fm<T>(f:Null<T>->Bool, x:Null<T>):String return f(x) + "|" + x;

	static function m1<T>(f:(Null<T>->Bool)->Void, x:T):String {
		f(v -> v == null);
		return "m1 " + x;
	}

	static function m3<T>(f:(Void->Null<T>)->Void, x:T):Void f(() -> x);

	static function optArr<T>(x:Int, ?a:Array<T>):String return a == null ? "none" : a[1] + "|" + (a[1] == null);

	static function retThunks<T>(x:T):Array<Void->Null<T>> return [() -> x];

	static function retCb<T>(x:T):Null<T>->String return v -> v + "|" + x;

	static function retOpt<T>(x:T):Option<Null<T>> return Some(x);

	static function twoB<A, X>(f:A->X, a:A):Null<X> return f(a);

	static function main() {
		var nn:Null<Int> = null, n5:Null<Int> = 5;
		var g:Array<Null<Int>> = [1, null, 3];
		var dg:Array<Array<Null<Int>>> = [[null, 2]];
		t(() -> deep(dg));
		t(() -> cbn((v:Null<Int>) -> v == null, nn));
		t(() -> cbn((v:Null<Int>) -> v == null, n5));
		t(() -> cbf((v:Null<Int>) -> v == null, nn));
		t(() -> cbr(() -> nn));
		t(() -> cbr(() -> n5));
		cbn4((v:Null<Int>) -> Sys.println("cbn4 " + v), nn);
		new K<String>().each((v:Null<Int>) -> Sys.println("each " + v), nn);
		t(() -> fm((v:Null<Int>) -> v == null, nn));
		t(() -> m1((h:Null<Int>->Bool) -> Sys.println("m1 h " + h(nn)), nn));
		m3((h:Void->Null<Int>) -> Sys.println("m3 " + h()), nn);
		t(() -> optArr(1, g));
		t(() -> optArr(1));
		t(() -> retThunks(nn)[0]() == null);
		t(() -> retCb(nn)(nn));
		t(() -> switch (retOpt(nn)) {
			case Some(v): "opt " + v;
			case None: "none";
		});
		t(() -> twoB(v -> v, nn));
		t(() -> twoB((v:Int) -> nn, 1));
		var b = new B<Null<Int>>(null);
		t(() -> b.wrapC(nn) == null);
		t(() -> b.mapN(v -> v));
		t(() -> b.mapN(v -> v) == null);
		t(() -> b.pick(nn, nn) + " " + b.pick(n5, nn));
		function lw<T>(x:T):Null<T> return x;
		function lp<T>(x:T):T return x;
		function le<T>(f:Null<T>->Void, x:T) f(x);
		function lz<T>(x:Null<T>):String return "lz " + x;
		function lb<T>(x:T, y:Null<T>):String return "lb " + x + "|" + y;
		function ld<T>(f:(Null<T>->Void)->Void, x:T):Void f(v -> Sys.println("ld " + v + "|" + x));
		t(() -> lw(nn));
		t(() -> lw(nn) == null);
		t(() -> lp(nn) == null);
		le((v:Null<Int>) -> Sys.println("le " + v), nn);
		t(() -> lz(nn));
		t(() -> lb(nn, nn));
		ld((h:Null<Int>->Void) -> h(nn), nn);
		t(() -> haxe.Serializer.run(lw(nn)) + " " + haxe.Serializer.run(b.wrapC(nn)) + " " + haxe.Serializer.run(cbr(() -> nn)));
	}
}

class G<T> {

	public function new(v:T) this.v = v;
