# Types notes §8.12 (probe serial); one map key, so the output is stable.
--- generic-class-serial @gencs
// Serializer round trips through generic classes and typed generic fields (data-observable).
class C { public var x = 1; public function new() {} }
class G<T> { public var v:T; public function new(v:T) this.v = v; }
class Holder {
	public var ai:Array<Int>;
	public var ac:Array<C>;
	public var gc:G<C>;
	public var gi:G<Int>;
	public var ani:Array<Null<Int>>;
	public var ms:Map<String, Int>;
	public function new() {}
}
class P {
	static function t(l:String, f:() -> Dynamic) {
		try Sys.println(l + ": " + f()) catch (e:Dynamic) Sys.println(l + " threw " + Type.getClassName(Type.getClass(e)) + " " + e);
	}
	static function main() {
		var g = new G<Int>(3);
		var s = haxe.Serializer.run(g);
		Sys.println(s);
		t("unser G", () -> { var u:Dynamic = haxe.Unserializer.run(s); Std.string(Type.getClass(u)) + " v=" + u.v; });
		var h = new Holder();
		h.ai = [1, 2];
		h.ac = [new C()];
		h.gc = new G(new C());
		h.gi = new G(5);
		h.ani = [1, null];
		h.ms = ["a" => 1];
		var hs = haxe.Serializer.run(h);
		Sys.println(hs);
		t("unser Holder", () -> {
			var u:Holder = haxe.Unserializer.run(hs);
			Std.string(Type.getClass(u.ai)) + " " + Std.string(Type.getClass(u.ac)) + " " + Std.string(Type.getClass(u.gc)) + " " + Std.string(Type.getClass(u.gi)) + " " + Std.string(Type.getClass(u.ani)) + " " + Std.string(Type.getClass(u.ms)) + " | " + haxe.Serializer.run(u);
		});
	}

# Review Focus 5 of plan 3c: stored records whose fields are generic instantiations (a Map<String,C>, an
# Array<Int>, a List<String>, a G<C> and a Map<E,Int>), and a G<Int> on its own. rt also changes each
# unserialized record through its typed fields before it serializes it again, as a server does with
# stored data. Every StringMap has one key, so the output does not depend on String.GetHashCode.
--- serial-generic-classes @serial + -D net-ver=40
import haxe.Serializer;
import haxe.Unserializer;

enum E {
	A;
	B(i:Int);
}

class C {
	public var x:Int;

	public function new(x:Int) {
		this.x = x;
	}
}

class G<T> {
	public var v:T;

	public function new(v:T) {
		this.v = v;
	}
}

class Rec {
	public var sm:Map<String, C>;
	public var ai:Array<Int>;
	public var ls:List<String>;
	public var gc:G<C>;
	public var em:Map<E, Int>;

	public function new() {}
}

class P {
	static function values():Array<{name:String, v:Dynamic}> {
		var r = new Rec();
		r.sm = ["c" => new C(1)];
		r.ai = [1, 2];
		r.ls = new List();
		r.ls.add("s");
		r.gc = new G(new C(2));
		r.em = [A => 1, B(2) => 2];
		var shared = new C(3);
		var s = new Rec();
		s.sm = ["k" => shared];
		s.ai = [];
		s.ls = new List();
		s.gc = new G(shared);
		s.em = new Map();
		return [
			{name: "rec", v: r}, {name: "recnull", v: new Rec()}, {name: "recshared", v: s}, {name: "gint", v: new G<Int>(5)},
			{name: "recs", v: [r, s]},
		];
	}

	// Uses an unserialized record's typed fields.
	static function change(v:Dynamic) {
		if (Std.isOfType(v, Array)) {
			var a:Array<Dynamic> = v;
			for (e in a)
				change(e);
		} else if (Std.isOfType(v, Rec)) {
			var r:Rec = v;
			if (r.sm != null)
				for (k in [for (k in r.sm.keys()) k])
					r.sm[k].x += 10;
			if (r.ai != null)
				r.ai.push(r.ai.length);
			if (r.ls != null)
				r.ls.add("t");
			if (r.gc != null)
				r.gc.v.x++;
			if (r.em != null)
				r.em.set(A, r.em.exists(A) ? r.em.get(A) + 1 : 0);
		}
	}

	static function serialize(name:String, v:Dynamic):String {
		var s = new Serializer();
		if (name.indexOf("+cache+idx") >= 0) {
			s.useCache = true;
			s.useEnumIndex = true;
		}
		s.serialize(v);
		return s.toString();
	}

	static function error(ex:Dynamic):String {
		var s = if (Std.isOfType(ex, cs.system.Exception)) {
			var ce:cs.system.Exception = ex;
			Type.getClassName(Type.getClass(ex)) + ": " + ce.Message;
		} else Std.string(ex);
		return "EXC " + StringTools.replace(StringTools.replace(s, "\r", ""), "\n", "\\n");
	}

	static var out = new StringBuf();

	static function add(name:String, v:Dynamic) {
		out.add(name + "\t" + (try serialize(name, v) catch (ex:Dynamic) error(ex)) + "\n");
	}

	static function main() {
		var args = Sys.args();
		if (args[0] == "gen") {
			for (e in values()) {
				add(e.name, e.v);
				add(e.name + "+cache+idx", e.v);
			}
			cs.system.io.File.WriteAllText(args[1], out.toString());
		} else if (args[0] == "rt") {
			for (line in cs.system.io.File.ReadAllText(args[1]).split("\n")) {
				if (line == "")
					continue;
				var i = line.indexOf("\t");
				var name = line.substr(0, i), ser = line.substr(i + 1);
				if (StringTools.startsWith(ser, "EXC ")) {
					out.add(line + "\n");
					continue;
				}
				try {
					var v:Dynamic = new Unserializer(ser).unserialize();
					change(v);
					add(name, v);
				} catch (ex:Dynamic) {
					out.add(name + "\t" + error(ex) + "\n");
				}
			}
			cs.system.io.File.WriteAllText(args[2], out.toString());
		}
		Sys.print(out.toString());
	}
}

class Holder {
	public var n:Nullable_1<Int>;
	public var dt:Nullable_1<DateTime>;
	public function new() {}
}

class P {
	static function show(d:Dynamic) return d == null ? "null" : Std.string(d) + ":" + Type.getClassName(Type.getClass(d));
	static function main() {
		var some = Nul.Maybe(true), none = Nul.Maybe(false);
		// Nullable into Dynamic
		var d1:Dynamic = some, d2:Dynamic = none;
		trace("dyn", show(d1), show(d2), d1 == null, d2 == null);
		trace("trace direct", some, none);
		trace("isOfType", Std.isOfType(d1, Int), Std.isOfType(d2, Int));
		trace("ShowObj", Nul.ShowObj(some), Nul.ShowObj(none));
		// Dynamic into Nullable
		var dd:Dynamic = 4;
		var back:Nullable_1<Int> = dd;
		trace("from dyn", back.HasValue, back.Value);
		var dn:Dynamic = null;
		var back2:Nullable_1<Int> = dn;
		trace("from dyn null", back2.HasValue);
		// Reflection on a Haxe object with a Nullable field
		var h = new Holder();
		h.n = some;
		trace("Reflect.field", show(Reflect.field(h, "n")), show(Reflect.field(h, "dt")));
		Reflect.setField(h, "n", 12);
		trace("Reflect.setField", h.n.HasValue, h.n.Value);
		Reflect.setField(h, "n", null);
		trace("Reflect.setField null", h.n.HasValue);
		// Reflection on a .NET object's Nullable property
		var m = new Model();
		m.NProp = some;
		trace("Reflect.field net", show(Reflect.field(m, "NProp")), show(Reflect.field(m, "NDate")));
		Reflect.setProperty(m, "NProp", 21);
		trace("Reflect.setProperty net", m.NProp.Value);
		// Serializer
		h.n = some;
		trace("serialize", haxe.Serializer.run(h));
		var l = Nul.ListOf();
		trace("get_Item", l.get_Item(0).HasValue, l.get_Item(1).HasValue, Nul.ShowList(l));
		var arr:Array<Nullable_1<Int>> = [some, none];
		trace("array", arr.length, arr[0].Value, arr[1].HasValue, haxe.Serializer.run(arr));
		var dyn:Dynamic = arr;
		trace("dyn array", dyn[0], dyn[1]);
		var dd:Dynamic = 4.0;
		try { var back:Nullable_1<Int> = dd; trace("from dyn float", back.Value); } catch (e:Dynamic) trace("from dyn float throws", Type.getClassName(Type.getClass(e)));
	}
}

# M4Lib (@netlib=M4Lib), generic methods. Non-generic overloads declared after generic ones with the same parameter

--- netlib-generic-overloads @gencs @netlib=M4Lib + -D net-ver=40
import m4.*;
import cs.system.collections.generic.IList_1;

class HxThing { public var v:Int; public function new(v) this.v = v; public function toString() return "HxThing" + v; }
enum Color { Red; Green; }
class Box<T> { public var x:T; public function new(x) this.x = x; }

class P {
	static function main() {
		var s = new Sess();
		var is:ISess = s;
		Sys.println(is.Make("Blob"));
		var t:cs.system.Type = cs.Lib.toNativeType(Rec);
		Sys.println(is.Make(t));

# null into .NET value types is default(T), a Nullable against null is !HasValue, any other struct against null is
# Equals(default(T)), an unsafe cast between Nullable and struct pairs boxes then converts, and a Nullable in a string is
# Std.string of its box (a missing value prints null). Ruling 2, 3 and 5.
--- netlib-nullable-null @gencs @netlib
import cs.system.Nullable_1;
import cs.system.DateTime;
import vallib.Nul;
import vallib.Model;

@:nativeGen class NModel {
	public var a:Nullable_1<Int> = null;
	public var d:Nullable_1<DateTime> = null;
	public var b:Nullable_1<Bool> = new Nullable_1<Bool>(true);
	public function new() {}
}

class HModel {
	public var a:Nullable_1<Int> = null;
	public var b:Nullable_1<Bool>;
	public function new() {}
}

class P {
	static function ret(b:Bool):Nullable_1<DateTime> {
		if (b) return null;
		return new Nullable_1<DateTime>(new DateTime(2021, 3, 4));
	}
	static function retT(b:Bool, x:Null<Int>):Nullable_1<Int> {
		return b ? null : x != null ? new Nullable_1<Int>(x) : null;
	}
	static function idOf(v:Nullable_1<Int>):Null<Int> {
		return v.HasValue ? v.Value : null;
	}
	static function main() {
		// null into locals, fields, returns, arguments, properties
		var n:Nullable_1<Int> = null;
		trace("local", n.HasValue);
		var nm = new NModel();
		trace("nativeGen fields", nm.a.HasValue, nm.d.HasValue, nm.b.HasValue, nm.b.Value);
		var hm = new HModel();
		trace("haxe fields", hm.a.HasValue, hm.b.HasValue);
		trace("ret", ret(true).HasValue, ret(false).HasValue, ret(false).Value.Year);
		trace("retT", retT(true, 1).HasValue, retT(false, 2).Value, retT(false, null).HasValue);
		trace("arg", Nul.Show(null), Nul.Show(new Nullable_1<Int>(3)), Nul.Show(Nul.Maybe(true)));
		var m = new Model();
		m.NProp = new Nullable_1<Int>(7);
		m.NField = new Nullable_1<Int>(8);
		m.NBool = true ? new Nullable_1<Bool>(false) : null;
		trace("props", m.ToString());
		m.NProp = null;
		m.NField = null;
		m.NBool = false ? new Nullable_1<Bool>(false) : null;
		trace("props null", m.ToString());
		// == null and != null
		var some = Nul.Maybe(true), none = Nul.Maybe(false);
		trace("eq", some == null, some != null, none == null, none != null, null == none, null != some);
		trace("prop eq", m.NProp == null, null != m.NProp);
		m.NProp = new Nullable_1<Int>(1);
		trace("prop eq2", m.NProp == null, null != m.NProp);
		// HasValue, Value, GetValueOrDefault
		trace("value", some.HasValue, some.Value, none.HasValue, none.GetValueOrDefault(), none.GetValueOrDefault(11));
		try { trace(none.Value); } catch (e:Dynamic) { trace("none.Value throws", Type.getClassName(Type.getClass(e))); }
		trace("idOf", idOf(some), idOf(none));
		// arithmetic and comparisons on .Value
		trace("math", some.Value + 1, some.Value < 10, some.Value == 5);
	}
}

	public var Label(get, never):String;

	public function set_Count(v:Int) { n = v * 2; return n; }

		var f = Type.getInstanceFields(Counter); f.sort(Reflect.compare); Sys.println(f);

		Sys.println(c.Count = 6);

		var r = Reflect.fields(c); r.sort(Reflect.compare); Sys.println(r);

# Every access goes through the accessors: initializers (instance and static), compound assignment, ++ with its value,

--- property-vars-access @gencs
import cs.system.DateTime;

class Counter {
	@:property public var n:Int = 1;
	@:property public var label:String;
	@:property public static var total:Int = 10;
	@:property public static var tag:String;
	public var plain:Int = 0;
	public function new() {
		label = "c";
	}
	public function bump():Int {
		n += 2;
		total++;
		return n++;
	}

@:nativeGen

	@:property public var v:Float = 1.5;
	public function new() {}

class Box<T> {
	@:property public var item:T;
	@:property public var hits:Int = 0;
	public function new(item:T) {
		this.item = item;
	}
	public function take():T {
		hits++;
		return item;
	}
}

@:struct
class Pair {
	@:property public var a:Int;
	@:property public var b:String;
	public function new(a:Int, b:String) {
		this.a = a;
		this.b = b;
	}

class P {
	static function main() {
		var c = new Counter();
		Sys.println(c.bump() + " " + c.n + " " + Counter.total);
		Sys.println((c.n *= 3) + " " + (c.label += "x") + " " + (Counter.total -= 1) + " " + (Counter.tag = "t"));

		Reflect.setProperty(c, "label", "y");

		dc.n++;
		Sys.println(dc.n + " " + dc.label + " " + Reflect.field(Counter, "total") + " " + Reflect.field(Counter, "tag"));
		Reflect.setField(Counter, "total", 7);
		Sys.println(Counter.total);
		var f = Reflect.fields(c); f.sort(Reflect.compare); Sys.println(f);
		var i = Type.getInstanceFields(Counter); i.sort(Reflect.compare); Sys.println(i);
		var s = Type.getClassFields(Counter); s.sort(Reflect.compare); Sys.println(s);
		var t = cs.Lib.toNativeType(Counter);
		var ps = [for (p in t.GetProperties()) p.Name]; ps.sort(Reflect.compare); Sys.println(ps);
		var fs = [for (x in t.GetFields()) x.Name]; fs.sort(Reflect.compare); Sys.println(fs);
		var st = new Stamp();
		Sys.println(st.at.Year + " " + st.at.AddYears(1).Year);
		st.at = st.at.AddDays(40);
		Sys.println(st.at.Month);
		st.v += 1;
		Sys.println(st.v++ + " " + st.v);
		var nf = Reflect.fields(st); nf.sort(Reflect.compare); Sys.println(nf);
		var ni = Type.getInstanceFields(Stamp); ni.sort(Reflect.compare); Sys.println(ni);
		var b = new Box("x");
		Sys.println(b.take() + b.take() + " " + b.hits);
		b.item = "y";
		var db:Dynamic = b;
		Sys.println(db.item + " " + db.hits);
		var bt = cs.Lib.toNativeType(Box);
		var bps = [for (p in bt.GetProperties()) p.Name]; bps.sort(Reflect.compare); Sys.println(bps);

		Sys.println(p.a + p.b);
		var pt = cs.Lib.toNativeType(Pair);

# A physical @:property var whose class also declares get_X or set_X: C# reserves those names for the property's
# accessors (gencs's C#: CS0082).
--- property-var-compiler-generated @gencs
@:nativeGen
class Model {
	@:property public var name:String = "";
	@:property public static var total:Int = 3;
	public function new() {}
}
class Box<T> {
	@:property public var item:T;
	@:property public static var made:Int;
	public function new(t:T) item = t;
}
class Plain {
	@:property public var x:Float = 1.5;
	public function new() {}
}
class P {
	static function main() {
		var m = new Model();
		var b = new Box<String>("s");
		var p = new Plain();
		var CG = cs.Lib.toNativeType(cs.system.runtime.compilerservices.CompilerGeneratedAttribute);
		for (t in [cs.Lib.toNativeType(Model), cs.Lib.getNativeType(b).GetGenericTypeDefinition(), cs.Lib.toNativeType(Plain)]) {
			var all:cs.system.reflection.BindingFlags = new cs.Flags(cs.system.reflection.BindingFlags.Public) | cs.system.reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | cs.system.reflection.BindingFlags.Instance | cs.system.reflection.BindingFlags.Static | cs.system.reflection.BindingFlags.DeclaredOnly;
			var out = [];
			for (f in t.GetFields(all)) if (f.IsDefined(CG, false)) out.push("field " + f.Name);
			for (mm in t.GetMethods(all)) if (mm.IsDefined(CG, false)) out.push("method " + mm.Name);
			for (pp in t.GetProperties(all)) if (pp.IsDefined(CG, false)) out.push("property " + pp.Name);
			out.sort(Reflect.compare);
			Sys.println(t.Name + ": " + out.join(", "));
		}
	}
}

# Haxe functions as .NET delegates (M4Lib section 3), gencs's three shapes: lambdas without and with
# captures (a closure class's Delegate method), a static method (a method group), an instance closure on
# a receiver the inliner binds to a local and a local Function (conversion wrappers); List.Find with a
# lambda, a generic method taking Func<T,R>, a Predicate var, `new Note(...)`, add_/remove_ of an event,
# .Invoke, and a capturing lambda M4Lib keeps and calls twice from another thread after its frame returns.
--- netlib-delegates @gencs @netlib=M4Lib + -D net-ver=40
import m4.*;
import cs.system.Func_2;
import cs.system.Predicate_1;

class P {
	var tag:String;
	function new(t) tag = t;
	function isMine(s:String):Bool return s == tag;
	static function isLong(s:String):Bool return s.length > 1;
	static function keep(prefix:String) {
		var count = 0;
		Later.Keep((s) -> {
			count++;
			return prefix + s + count;
		});
	}
	static function main() {
		var c = new Client();
		Sys.println(c.Run());
		c.Validate = (sender, cert, errors) -> errors == 0;
		Sys.println(c.Run());
		var limit = 1;
		c.Validate = (sender, cert, errors) -> errors < limit;
		Sys.println(c.Run());
		c.Filter = (s:String) -> s.length > 1;
		Sys.println(c.RunFilter());
		c.Filter = isLong;
		Sys.println(c.RunFilter());
		c.Filter = new P("a").isMine;
		Sys.println(c.RunFilter());
		var f = (s:String) -> s == "bb";
		c.Filter = f;
		Sys.println(c.RunFilter());
		Sys.println(c.Filter.Invoke("bb"));
		var names = Lists.Names();
		Sys.println(names.Find((s) -> s.charAt(0) == "b"));
		var want = "cy";
		Sys.println(names.Find((s) -> s == want));
		Sys.println(Gen.Apply((x:Int) -> x + 1, 3));
		var p:Predicate_1<String> = (s) -> s.length == 3;
		Sys.println(names.FindAll(p).Count);
		c.Fire("before");
		var n = new Note((s) -> Sys.println("noted " + s));
		c.add_Noted(n);
		c.Fire("x");
		c.remove_Noted(n);
		c.Fire("y");
		var fn:Func_2<String, Bool> = c.Filter;
		Sys.println(fn.Invoke("q"));
		keep("p");
		Sys.println(Later.CallTwice());
	}
}

# Method groups on `this` and on a local, a lambda capturing `this`, `d1 + d2` (Delegate.Combine),
# `new Thread(() -> ...)`, and removing an event handler with a delegate made again from the same
# method: .NET delegate equality compares target and method, so the method group must be a delegate over
# onNote itself and the remove leaves no handler.
--- netlib-delegates-methods-and-combine @gencs @netlib=M4Lib + -D net-ver=40
import m4.*;
class P {
	var tag:String;
	function new(t) tag = t;
	function isMine(s:String):Bool return s == tag;
	function onNote(s:String):Void Sys.println(tag + " noted " + s);
	function run(c:Client) {
		c.Filter = isMine;
		Sys.println(c.RunFilter());
		c.Filter = (s) -> s == tag;
		Sys.println(c.RunFilter());
		c.add_Noted(this.onNote);
		c.remove_Noted(this.onNote);
		c.Fire("x");
	}
	static function main() {
		var c = new Client();
		var me = new P("a");
		c.Filter = me.isMine;
		Sys.println(c.RunFilter());
		me.run(c);
		var d1 = new Note((s) -> Sys.println("one " + s));
		var d2 = new Note((s) -> Sys.println("two " + s));
		var both = d1 + d2;
		both.Invoke("z");
		var t = new cs.system.threading.Thread(() -> Sys.println("in thread"));
		t.Start();
		t.Join();
	}
}

# Method groups over a virtual Haxe method (`dup; ldvirtftn`): through a subclass receiver that inherits an
# override, through a Haxe interface receiver and through a base-class receiver, all dispatch to C.has; a
# final method uses `ldftn`. Two delegates made from the same object and method are equal, and
# Method.DeclaringType names the class that declares the method the delegate runs.
--- delegate-method-group-virtual-dispatch @gencs + -D net-ver=40
import cs.system.Func_2;
import cs.system.Delegate;

interface I {
	function has(s:String):Bool;
}

class B implements I {
	public function new() {}
	public function has(s:String):Bool return s == "b";
	public final function fin(s:String):Bool return s == "f";
}

class C extends B {
	public function new() super();
	override public function has(s:String):Bool return s == "c";
}

class D extends C {
	public function new() super();
}

class P {
	static function show(x:Func_2<String, Bool>, y:Func_2<String, Bool>) {
		var a:Delegate = cast x;
		var b:Delegate = cast y;
		Sys.println(a.Method.DeclaringType.Name + "." + a.Method.Name + " eq=" + cs.system.Object._Equals(a, b));
	}
	static function main() {
		var d = new D();
		var f:Func_2<String, Bool> = d.has;
		Sys.println(f.Invoke("c"));
		var i:I = d;
		var g:Func_2<String, Bool> = i.has;
		Sys.println(g.Invoke("c"));
		var h:Func_2<String, Bool> = d.fin;
		Sys.println(h.Invoke("f"));
		var b:B = d;
		var k:Func_2<String, Bool> = b.has;
		Sys.println(k.Invoke("c"));
		show(f, k);
		show(g, f);
		show(h, h);
	}
}

# Ruling X: an integer constant or a null literal still binds where one overload applies, as in C#: the exact int
# I(int), a constant that does not fit in a byte (B(object)), a widening (L(long)), a null into the one reference
# candidate R(string), and a null into an @:overload extern, which gencs casts to the declared type (N(object)).

	static function I(x:Int):String;
	static function B(x:Int):String;
	static function L(x:Int):String;
	static function R(s:String):String;

		trace(ByVal.R(null));
		trace(ByVal.R("s"));

# The spec's first-class rethrow: `throw e` of an unchanged catch variable, directly in its own catch, is
# `rethrow` in hxc. gencs writes `throw e;`, which resets the trace (the [gencs] section). A reassigned e, a
# `throw e` inside a nested catch (rethrow would throw e2) and the haxe.Exception and Dynamic catches (the
# filter throws Exception.thrown(e), a call's result) stay plain throws, as in gencs.
--- rethrow-throw-caught-value @gencs
// `throw e` of the caught value, unchanged, directly in its catch: hxc emits `rethrow`, which keeps the stack
// trace (the spec's first-class rethrow); gencs writes `throw e;`, which resets it. Reassigned, thrown from a
// nested catch, or caught as haxe.Exception or Dynamic (the filter wraps those), it stays a plain throw.
class MyErr extends haxe.Exception {}
class P {
	static function thrower():Void {
		throw new cs.system.InvalidOperationException("boom");
	}
	static function hxThrower():Void {
		throw new MyErr("hx");
	}
	static function report(tag:String, e:cs.system.Exception) {
		Sys.println(tag + ": " + cs.Lib.getNativeType(e).Name + ", thrower in trace " + (e.StackTrace.indexOf("hrower") >= 0));
	}
	static function native() {
		try thrower() catch (e:cs.system.Exception) { Sys.println("cleanup"); throw e; }
	}
	static function haxeSubclass() {
		try hxThrower() catch (e:MyErr) throw e;
	}
	static function reassigned() {
		try thrower() catch (e:cs.system.Exception) { e = new cs.system.Exception("other"); throw e; }
	}
	static function fromNestedCatch() {
		try thrower() catch (e:cs.system.Exception) {
			try throw "inner" catch (e2:Dynamic) throw e;
		}
	}
	static function haxeException() {
		try thrower() catch (e:haxe.Exception) throw e;
	}
	static function dynamicCatch() {
		try thrower() catch (e:Dynamic) throw e;
	}
	static function main() {
		try native() catch (e:cs.system.Exception) report("native", e);
		try haxeSubclass() catch (e:cs.system.Exception) report("haxe subclass", e);
		try reassigned() catch (e:cs.system.Exception) report("reassigned", e);
		try fromNestedCatch() catch (e:cs.system.Exception) report("from nested catch", e);
		try haxeException() catch (e:cs.system.Exception) report("haxe.Exception", e);
		try dynamicCatch() catch (e:cs.system.Exception) report("Dynamic", e);
	}
}

# `throw e` of a catch variable that a closure captures. A closure that only reads e leaves it a local of the
# catch, so `throw e` is `rethrow` in hxc and keeps the stack trace (gencs's `throw e;` resets it). A closure
# that writes e makes CapturedVars box it, so it is no longer a local and the throw stays a plain `throw` of its
# current value (the new exception, with no trace), as in gencs.
--- rethrow-captured-catch-variable @gencs
class P {
	static function thrower():Void {
		throw new cs.system.InvalidOperationException("boom");
	}
	static function report(tag:String, e:cs.system.Exception) {
		Sys.println(tag + ": " + e.Message + ", thrower in trace " + (e.StackTrace.indexOf("hrower") >= 0));
	}
	static function readByClosure() {
		try thrower() catch (e:cs.system.InvalidOperationException) {
			var f = () -> e.Message;
			Sys.println("closure read " + f());
			throw e;
		}
	}
	static function writeByClosure() {
		try thrower() catch (e:cs.system.InvalidOperationException) {
			var f = () -> { e = new cs.system.InvalidOperationException("other"); };
			f();
			throw e;
		}
	}
	static function main() {
		try readByClosure() catch (e:cs.system.Exception) report("read by closure", e);
		try writeByClosure() catch (e:cs.system.Exception) report("written by closure", e);
	}
}
===
[run]
closure read boom
read by closure: boom, thrower in trace true
written by closure: other, thrower in trace false
[gencs]
closure read boom

# A first-class rethrow that is not directly inside a catch, or in a local function inside one, is a lasting error
# (C# error CS0156 in gencs).
--- rethrow-outside-catch-is-an-error
class P {
	static function bare(e:cs.system.Exception) {
		cs.Lib.rethrow(e);
	}
	static function inClosure() {
		try {
			Sys.println("t");
		} catch (e:cs.system.Exception) {
			var f = () -> cs.Lib.rethrow(e);
			f();
		}
	}
	static function main() {
		try bare(null) catch (e:cs.system.Exception) {}
		inClosure();
	}
}

# Placeholder substitution and result conversion as gencs does them. Names in the C# text (`i + 10`) and .NET
# members (`{0}.ToUpper()`) are covered by the name-resolution cases.
--- inline-cs-placeholders @gencs
// cs.Syntax.code and untyped __cs__ placeholders: each {N} is its argument's value as a unit (`(i + 1) * 3`),
// in the argument's own type (an Int stays an int, so `{0} * 2` is int arithmetic). A placeholder used twice
// evaluates its argument twice, as gencs's text substitution does. cs.Syntax.code's result is Dynamic,
// converted to where it goes (Runtime.toInt, toDouble, toString, toBool); untyped __cs__'s takes the type
// it is used as, with no conversion.
class P {
	var fld:Int = 7;
	static var sfld:String = "s";
	public function new() {}
	static function take(i:Int):Int return i * 2;
	static function side():Int { Sys.println("side"); return 3; }
	static inline function doubled(x:Int):Int {
		var y = x * 2;
		return y;
	}
	function inst():Void {
		var a:Int = untyped __cs__("{0} + 1", fld);
		var b:Int = cs.Syntax.code("{0} + 1", this.fld);
		Sys.println(a + " " + b);
		var c:String = cs.Syntax.code("{0}.ToUpper()", sfld);
		Sys.println(c);
	}
	static function main() {
		var i = 5;
		var f = 2.5;
		var s = "hi";
		var d:Dynamic = 4;
		var r1:Int = cs.Syntax.code("{0} * 2", i);
		var r2:Float = cs.Syntax.code("{0} * 2", f);
		var r3:String = cs.Syntax.code("{0} + \"!\"", s);
		var r4:Int = cs.Syntax.code("(int){0} + 1", d);
		var r7:Int = cs.Syntax.code("{0} + {0}", side());
		var r8 = take(cs.Syntax.code("{0}", 21));
		var r9:Int = cs.Syntax.code("{0} * 3", i + 1);
		var r10 = cs.Syntax.code("{0}", "lit");
		var r11:Int = cs.Syntax.code("{1} - {0}", 1, 10);
		Sys.println(r1 + "," + r2 + "," + r3 + "," + r4 + "," + r7 + "," + r8 + "," + r9 + "," + r10 + "," + r11);
		if (cs.Syntax.code("{0} > 3", i)) Sys.println("gt");
		var u:Int = untyped __cs__("i + 10");
		Sys.println(u);
		var r12:Int = cs.Syntax.code("{0} + {0}", {
			var t = side();
			t * 2;
		});
		var r13:Int = cs.Syntax.code("{0} + {0}", doubled(side()));
		Sys.println(r12 + "," + r13);
		new P().inst();
	}
}

# Literals, operators, keyword-type casts and `is` in inline C#, with C#'s numeric promotion: an int with a
# long computes in long, a uint with an int in long, a char in int; `/` of two ints is integer division;
# comparisons of doubles and unsigned values are C#'s; && and || short-circuit.
--- inline-cs-operators @gencs
class P {
	static function side(tag:String, b:Bool):Bool { Sys.println(tag); return b; }
	static function main() {

		var u:UInt = 0xEE6B2800;

		Sys.println(untyped __cs__("(int)(long){0}", ol));

		Sys.println(untyped __cs__("(object){0} == null", str));

		Sys.println(b + " " + x);

		var ul:cs.StdTypes.UInt64 = untyped __cs__("7UL");
		Sys.println(cs.Syntax.code("{0} - {1}", one, 5));
		Sys.println(cs.Syntax.code("{0} < {1}", one, 5));

	}

# Inline C#'s result goes into Null<T>, a type parameter and Dynamic as gencs converts a Dynamic there:
# Null<T>.ofDynamic, Runtime.genericCast (whose cast of an int to string fails, as in gencs), and boxing.
--- inline-cs-result-into-null-and-type-params @gencs
class P {

# A bare `throw` in inline C# is IL `rethrow`, which keeps the stack trace: in the catch, after a try/catch
# nested in it, after an if, in a loop, and in the cs.system.Exception catch the exceptions filter makes of a
# haxe.Exception catch. gencs writes `throw;` for each.
--- inline-cs-rethrow-bare @gencs
// A bare `throw` in inline C# (untyped __cs__ or cs.Syntax.code) rethrows the caught exception and keeps its
// stack trace: directly in the catch, after a try/catch nested in it, after an if, in a loop, and in the catch
// a haxe.Exception catch becomes. The trace still names the method that threw.
class P {
	static function thrower():Void {
		throw new cs.system.InvalidOperationException("boom");
	}
	static function hxThrower():Void {
		throw new haxe.Exception("hx");
	}
	static function report(tag:String, e:cs.system.Exception) {
		Sys.println(tag + ": " + cs.Lib.getNativeType(e).Name + ", thrower in trace " + (e.StackTrace.indexOf("hrower") >= 0));
	}
	static function direct() {
		try thrower() catch (e:cs.system.Exception) untyped __cs__("throw");
	}
	static function syntax() {
		try thrower() catch (e:cs.system.Exception) cs.Syntax.code("throw");
	}
	static function afterNestedTry() {
		try thrower() catch (e:cs.system.Exception) {
			try throw "inner" catch (e2:Dynamic) {}
			untyped __cs__("throw");
		}
	}
	static function afterIf(n:Int) {
		var log = [];
		try thrower() catch (e:cs.system.Exception) {
			if (n > 0) log.push("cleanup");
			untyped __cs__("throw");
		}
	}
	static function inLoop(n:Int) {
		try thrower() catch (e:cs.system.Exception) {
			var i = 0;
			while (i < n) {
				if (i == 1) untyped __cs__("throw");
				i++;
			}
		}
	}
	static function haxeCatch() {
		try hxThrower() catch (e:haxe.Exception) {
			Sys.println("caught " + e.message);
			cs.Syntax.code("throw");
		}
	}
	static function main() {
		try direct() catch (e:cs.system.Exception) report("direct", e);
		try syntax() catch (e:cs.system.Exception) report("syntax", e);
		try afterNestedTry() catch (e:cs.system.Exception) report("after nested try", e);
		try afterIf(1) catch (e:cs.system.Exception) report("after if", e);
		try inLoop(3) catch (e:cs.system.Exception) report("in loop", e);
		try haxeCatch() catch (e:cs.system.Exception) report("haxe.Exception catch", e);
	}
}

class P {

# `(decimal){0}` folds a constant as C# does (0 -> Decimal.Zero, 2.5 -> the five-part constructor with scale
# 1) and calls op_Implicit(int32)/op_Explicit(float64) on a variable; `1.0m` keeps its scale. new Decimal(x)
# is the double constructor in both compilers.
--- inline-cs-decimal @gencs
// `(decimal){0}` in inline C# (the server app's form) and decimal literals, against the Haxe forms that
// compile under both compilers: `new Decimal(x)` takes the double constructor (Haxe's overload choice), so a
// Float is rounded to 15 significant digits and 1.0 has scale 0, where the literal 1.0m has scale 1.
import cs.system.Decimal;
@:nativeGen
class Model {
	@:property
	public var value:Decimal = untyped __cs__("(decimal){0}", 0);
	public function new() {}
}
class P {
	static function scale(d:Decimal):Int return (Decimal.GetBits(d)[3] >> 16) & 0xFF;
	static function show(tag:String, d:Decimal) Sys.println(tag + " " + d + " scale " + scale(d));
	static function main() {
		show("model", new Model().value);
		var i = 7, f = 2.5;
		show("(decimal)0", untyped __cs__("(decimal){0}", 0));
		show("(decimal)2.5", untyped __cs__("(decimal){0}", 2.5));
		show("(decimal)int", untyped __cs__("(decimal){0}", i));
		show("(decimal)double", untyped __cs__("(decimal){0}", f));
		show("1.0m", untyped __cs__("1.0m"));
		show("123456789.123456789m", untyped __cs__("123456789.123456789m"));
		show("new Decimal(0)", new Decimal(0));
		show("new Decimal(1.0)", new Decimal(1.0));
		show("new Decimal(123456789.123456789)", new Decimal(123456789.123456789));
		show("new Decimal(10, 0, 0, false, 1)", new Decimal(10, 0, 0, false, 1));
	}
}

# The desktop app's and haxeui's forms beyond the spec's first list: `is`, keyword/array types, chained
# casts, comparisons and &&, int.MinValue, `new`, enum members, a property chain, a call on a cast, a call
# on a struct a method returns (needs a temporary and ldloca), and ZLibStream (a type no --net-std of the
# server app defines; hxc finds it through NetRefs, from the reference pack).
--- inline-cs-forms @gencs
// The other inline C# forms the desktop app and its libraries use: type tests (`is` with a dotted, keyword
// and array type), casts to keyword and array types and chained casts, comparisons and && on a long against
// int.MinValue/int.MaxValue with a placeholder used twice, `new` of a .NET class, enum members as arguments,
// a static property chain, a cast receiver with a chained call, and a call on a struct a method returns.
import haxe.io.Bytes;
class P {
	static function toHaxe(v:Dynamic):Dynamic {
		if (cs.Syntax.code("{0} is System.DBNull", v))
			return null;
		if (cs.Syntax.code("{0} is long", v)) {
			var l:cs.StdTypes.Int64 = cs.Syntax.code("(long){0}", v);
			if (cs.Syntax.code("({0} >= int.MinValue && {0} <= int.MaxValue)", l))
				return (cs.Syntax.code("(int){0}", l) : Int);
			return (cs.Syntax.code("(double){0}", l) : Float);
		}
		if (cs.Syntax.code("{0} is byte[]", v))
			return Bytes.ofData(cs.Syntax.code("(byte[]){0}", v));
		return v;
	}
	static var client:Dynamic = null;
	static function main() {
		var boxedLong:Dynamic = cs.system.Convert.ToInt64(5);
		var bigLong:Dynamic = cs.system.Convert.ToInt64(5000000000.0);
		var bytes:Dynamic = Bytes.ofString("ab").getData();
		Sys.println([toHaxe(cs.system.DBNull.Value), toHaxe(boxedLong), toHaxe(bigLong), (toHaxe(bytes) : Bytes).length, toHaxe("s")]);
		var id:Int = cs.Syntax.code("(int)(long){0}", boxedLong);
		Sys.println(id);
		Sys.println(cs.Syntax.code("global::System.Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture.Name") == "");
		var s = "Hello";
		Sys.println(cs.Syntax.code("{0}.StartsWith({1}, global::System.StringComparison.Ordinal)", s, "He"));
		Sys.println(cs.Syntax.code("{0}.EndsWith({1}, global::System.StringComparison.Ordinal)", "abc\u00AD", "abc"));
		client = cs.Syntax.code("new System.Text.StringBuilder()");
		var chained:String = cs.Syntax.code("((System.Text.StringBuilder){0}).Append({1}).ToString()", client, "chain");
		Sys.println(chained);
		var list = new cs.system.collections.generic.List_1<String>();
		list.Add("done");
		var moved:Bool = cs.Syntax.code("((System.Collections.Generic.List<string>){0}).GetEnumerator().MoveNext()", list);
		Sys.println(moved);
		var ms = new cs.system.io.MemoryStream();
		var z:cs.system.io.Stream = untyped __cs__("new global::System.IO.Compression.ZLibStream({0}, global::System.IO.Compression.CompressionLevel.Optimal, true)", ms);

# Names that resolve the same in gencs's C# and in the Haxe scope.
--- inline-cs-names @gencs
// Names in inline C# that gencs's C# resolves as the Haxe code means them: locals, `this`, the class's own
// fields and statics unqualified, inherited fields, a static through its class's name, a method call, a local
// read in nested loops (the server app's `cells[row, col]` shape), and a private field of another class
// reached through a field (haxe-strings' `this.sb.b`).
class Base {
	public var inherited:Int = 40;
	public function new() {}
}
class Buf {
	var sb = new StringBuf();
	public function new() {}
	public function add(s:String):Buf { sb.add(s); return this; }
	public function clear():Buf { untyped __cs__("this.sb.b.Clear()"); return this; }
	public function insert(pos:Int, item:String):Buf { untyped __cs__("this.sb.b.Insert(pos, item)"); return this; }
	public function insertChar(pos:Int, ch:Int):Buf { untyped __cs__("this.sb.b.Insert(pos, (System.Char)ch)"); return this; }
	public function toString() return sb.toString();
}
class P extends Base {
	var fld:Int = 7;
	static var sfld:Int = 8;
	static function hello(x:Int) return "hello" + x;
	function inst():Void {
		Sys.println(untyped __cs__("fld + sfld + inherited"));
		Sys.println(untyped __cs__("this.fld + P.sfld"));
		Sys.println(untyped __cs__("hello(fld)"));
	}
	static function hashOf(str:String):Bool return untyped __cs__("str.GetHashCode() == {0}", (str : cs.system.String).GetHashCode());
	static function main() {
		var row = 0;
		var total = 0;
		var items = [1, 2, 3];
		for (item in items) {
			row++;
			var col = 0;
			while (col < item) {
				col++;
				total += untyped __cs__("row * 10 + col");
			}
		}
		Sys.println(total);
		new P().inst();
		var b = new Buf().add("held");
		b.insert(1, "XY").insertChar(0, 65);
		Sys.println(b.toString());
		Sys.println(b.clear().add("z").toString());
		Sys.println(hashOf("abc"));
	}
}

# The server app's four reachable patterns, as written there.
--- inline-cs-serverapp-patterns @gencs @netlib
// The server app's inline C# shapes, unchanged: a bare `throw` after cleanup in a catch of cs.system.Exception,
// `cells[row, col]` on locals in nested loops (ValLib.Cells stands in for EPPlus's ExcelRange), `(decimal){0}`
// as a @:property var's initializer, and `new` of a .NET class with an enum member, as Zlib's stream does.
import cs.system.Decimal;
@:nativeGen
class CostBenefit {
	@:property
	public var value:Decimal = untyped __cs__("(decimal){0}", 0);
	public function new() {}
}
class Transaction {
	public function new() {}
	public function release() Sys.println("released");
}
class P {
	static function work(t:Transaction):Void {
		throw new cs.system.InvalidOperationException("failed");
	}
	static function handle() {
		var transaction:Transaction = null;
		try {
			transaction = new Transaction();
			work(transaction);
		} catch (e:cs.system.Exception) {
			if (transaction != null) transaction.release();
			untyped __cs__("throw"); // Throw the original exception to avoid lost stack trace
		}
	}
	static function sheet(rows:Array<Array<String>>):Int {
		var cells = new vallib.Cells();
		var sum = 0;
		var row = 0;
		for (r in rows) {
			row++;
			var col = 0;
			for (c in r) {
				col++;
				var cell:Int = untyped __cs__('cells[row, col]');
				sum += cell;
			}
		}
		return sum;
	}
	static function main() {
		try handle() catch (e:cs.system.Exception) Sys.println(e.Message + ", work in trace " + (e.StackTrace.indexOf("work") >= 0));
		Sys.println(sheet([["a", "b"], ["c"]]));
		Sys.println(new CostBenefit().value);
		var ms = new cs.system.io.MemoryStream();
		var z:cs.system.io.Stream = untyped __cs__("new global::System.IO.Compression.ZLibStream({0}, global::System.IO.Compression.CompressionLevel.Optimal, true)", ms);
		var data = haxe.io.Bytes.ofString("aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa").getData();
		z.Write(data, 0, data.Length);
		z.Dispose();
		var out = ms.ToArray();
		Sys.println(out.Length + " bytes, header " + StringTools.hex(out[0], 2));
	}
}

# More forms of the lift, which gencs's C# also resolves as the Haxe code means them: instance methods called by
# their simple name, through `this` and through a field, a static a Haxe superclass declares, a member of the
# .NET superclass, a local shadowing a field, a verbatim `@name`, and lifted names numbered after the call's own
# placeholders.
--- inline-cs-names-lifted-forms @gencs
class Base {
	static var baseStatic:Int = 5;
	public function new() {}
}
class Holder {
	public var count:Int = 2;
	public function new() {}
	public function twice(x:Int):Int return x * 2;
}
class Failure extends cs.system.Exception {
	public function new() super("lifted");
	public function describe():String return untyped __cs__("Message + \"!\"");
}
class P extends Base {
	var fld:Int = 7;
	var h = new Holder();

		Sys.println(untyped __cs__("bump(3) + this.bump(4)"));

	function shadow():Void {
		var fld = 100;
		Sys.println(untyped __cs__("fld"));
	}

		var p = new P();
		p.inst();
		p.shadow();

		Sys.println(cs.Syntax.code("@event * 2"));

# [probe caseE] The replacement proposed for the server app's nativepdf Zlib.hx (no @:classCode, no __cs__).
# hxc compiles it today, so the case passes now. The md5 is the one the original @:classCode helper gives under
# gencs (probe zlib).
--- serverapp-zlib-through-externs @gencs
import haxe.io.Bytes;

// The server app's nativepdf Zlib without @:classCode or __cs__: .NET's ZLibStream through hand-written externs,
// which the reference assemblies the app passes predate. Same bytes as the @:classCode helper (md5 38c405ad...).
class P {
	static function main() {
		var buf = new haxe.io.BytesBuffer();
		for (i in 0...300) buf.addString("stream " + (i % 17) + " ");
		var b = buf.getBytes();
		var big = Bytes.alloc(b.length + 50);
		big.blit(0, b, 0, b.length);
		var whole = Zlib.compress(b).toHex();
		var view = Zlib.compress(big.sub(0, b.length)).toHex();
		var s = new ZlibStream();
		s.write(b, 0, 100);
		s.write(b, 100, b.length - 100);
		var st = s.finish().toHex();
		trace(b.length, whole.length, whole.substr(0, 40));
		trace(whole == view, whole == st, Zlib.compress(Bytes.alloc(0)).toHex());
		trace(haxe.crypto.Md5.encode(whole));
	}
}



/**
 * zlib (RFC 1950) compression for PDF FlateDecode streams. C# has no haxe.zip.Compress, so it uses
 * .NET's ZLibStream through the externs at the end of this file.
 */
class Zlib {
	public static function compress(b:Bytes):Bytes {
		var s = new ZlibStream();
		s.write(b, 0, b.length);
		return s.finish();
	}
}

/**
 * zlib compression fed piece by piece: on C# through .NET's ZLibStream as it comes, so only the compressed bytes are
 * held; elsewhere collected and compressed at the end.
 */
class ZlibStream {
	var ms:cs.system.io.MemoryStream;
	var z:NetZLibStream;

	public function new() {
		ms = new cs.system.io.MemoryStream();
		z = new NetZLibStream(ms, NetCompressionLevel.Optimal, true);
	}

	public function write(b:Bytes, pos:Int, len:Int):Void {
		z.Write(b.getData(), pos, len);
	}

	/** The compressed data; nothing more can be written. */
	public function finish():Bytes {
		z.Dispose();
		return Bytes.ofData(ms.ToArray());
	}
}

/** .NET 6's System.IO.Compression.ZLibStream, which the --net-std reference assemblies predate. */
@:native("System.IO.Compression.ZLibStream")
extern class NetZLibStream {
	function new(stream:cs.system.io.Stream, level:NetCompressionLevel, leaveOpen:Bool);
	function Write(buffer:cs.NativeArray<cs.types.UInt8>, offset:Int, count:Int):Void;
	function Dispose():Void;
}

@:native("System.IO.Compression.CompressionLevel")
extern enum NetCompressionLevel {
	Optimal;
	Fastest;
	NoCompression;
	SmallestSize;
}

// path the apps take (a subclass's super(), Type.createEmptyInstance as the AMF reader does, serialization) is the
// same under gencs (functionCode kept) and hxc (functionCode compiled out); only `new BaseTextArea()` would differ.
abstract Guid(String) {

class P {
	static function props(t:cs.system.Type):String {
		var flags = new cs.Flags(BindingFlags.Public) | BindingFlags.NonPublic | BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.DeclaredOnly;
		var ps = t.GetProperties(flags);
		var out = [];
		for (i in 0...ps.Length) {
			var p = ps[i];
			var ix = p.GetIndexParameters();
			var ixs = [for (j in 0...ix.Length) ix[j].ParameterType.Name + " " + ix[j].Name];
			out.push(p.PropertyType.Name + " " + p.Name + "[" + ixs.join(",") + "] r=" + p.CanRead + " w=" + p.CanWrite
				+ " get=" + (p.GetGetMethod(true) == null ? "-" : p.GetGetMethod(true).Name + (p.GetGetMethod(true).IsPublic ? " public" : " private") + (p.GetGetMethod(true).IsVirtual ? " virtual" : "") + (p.GetGetMethod(true).IsFinal ? " final" : "")));
		}
		var dm = t.GetDefaultMembers();
		var dms = [for (i in 0...dm.Length) dm[i].Name];
		var attrs = t.GetCustomAttributes(false);
		var ats = [for (i in 0...attrs.Length) cs.Lib.getNativeType(attrs[i]).Name];
		ats.sort(Reflect.compare);
		return out.join("; ") + " | default=" + dms.join(",") + " | attrs=" + ats.join(",");
	}

	static function nonPublicMethods(t:cs.system.Type, filter:String):String {
		var flags = new cs.Flags(BindingFlags.NonPublic) | BindingFlags.Public | BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.DeclaredOnly;
		var ms = t.GetMethods(flags);
		var out = [];
		for (i in 0...ms.Length) if (ms[i].Name.indexOf(filter) >= 0) {
			var m = ms[i];
			out.push(m.Name + (m.IsPublic ? " public" : m.IsPrivate ? " private" : " other") + (m.IsVirtual ? " virtual" : "") + (m.IsFinal ? " final" : "") + (m.IsHideBySig ? " hidebysig" : "") + (m.IsSpecialName ? " specialname" : "") + (Std.string(m.Attributes).indexOf("NewSlot") >= 0 ? " newslot" : ""));
		}
		return out.join("; ");
	}

	static function attempt(name:String, f:Void->Dynamic) {
		try {
			Sys.println(name + ": " + Std.string(f()));
		} catch (e:Dynamic) {
			var s = Std.string(e).split("\n")[0].split("\r")[0];
			if (s.length > 110) s = s.substr(0, 110);
			Sys.println(name + ": EXC " + s);
		}
	}

	static function main() {
		var a = [1, 2, 3];
		var at = cs.Lib.getNativeType(a);
		Sys.println("Array<Int>: " + props(at));
		Sys.println("Array<Int> Item methods: " + nonPublicMethods(at, "Item"));
		var comp = cs.system.Type._GetType("Array");
		Sys.println("Array companion: " + props(comp));
		Sys.println("companion Item methods: " + nonPublicMethods(comp, "Item"));
		var g = new Grid();
		Sys.println("Grid: " + props(cs.Lib.getNativeType(g)));
		Sys.println("Grid Item methods: " + nonPublicMethods(cs.Lib.getNativeType(g), "Item"));
		Sys.println("Named: " + props(cs.Lib.getNativeType(new Named())));
		Sys.println("Grid fields: " + Type.getInstanceFields(Grid));
		Sys.println("Grid g[1]: " + g[1] + " " + (g[1] = 5) + " " + g[1]);
		attempt("Item via reflection", () -> at.GetProperty("Item").GetValue(a, cs.NativeArray.make((1 : Dynamic))));
		attempt("companion Item set 2.5", () -> { comp.GetProperty("Item").SetValue(a, (2.5 : Dynamic), cs.NativeArray.make((0 : Dynamic))); Std.string(a); });
		attempt("Reflect.field get_Item", () -> Reflect.field(a, "get_Item"));
		attempt("Reflect.callMethod get_Item", () -> Reflect.callMethod(a, Reflect.field(a, "get_Item"), [2]));
		var d:Dynamic = a;
		attempt("dynamic d.get_Item(1)", () -> d.get_Item(1));
		attempt("Reflect.hasField get_Item", () -> Reflect.hasField(a, "get_Item"));
		attempt("Grid reflect get_Item", () -> Reflect.callMethod(g, Reflect.field(g, "get_Item"), [0]));
	}
}

# [probe idx4] a[i] on a Haxe ArrayAccess class is its indexer in gencs's C# (compound and ++ evaluate receiver
# and index once; the value of an assignment is the value stored, not __set's result). A subclass overriding only
# __get gets its own get-only Item. A generic class's companion gets `object this[int key]`, implemented
# explicitly. hxc today: "array access is not supported yet" / "this kind of assignment is not supported yet".
--- haxe-class-indexers @gencs
import cs.system.reflection.BindingFlags;

// User classes with __get/__set: gencs gives each an indexer (any class, ArrayAccess or not), and Haxe's
// a[i] on an ArrayAccess class is that indexer in gencs's C#.
class Grid implements ArrayAccess<Int> {
	var cells = [10, 20, 30];
	public function new() {}
	public function __get(i:Int):Int { Sys.println("  __get " + i); return cells[i]; }
	public function __set(i:Int, v:Int):Int { Sys.println("  __set " + i + " " + v); cells[i] = v; return -1; }
}

class Sub extends Grid {
	public function new() super();
	override public function __get(i:Int):Int return 100 + super.__get(i);
}

class Vec<T> implements ArrayAccess<T> {
	var items:Array<T>;
	public function new(items:Array<T>) this.items = items;
	public function __get(i:Int):T return items[i];
	public function __set(i:Int, v:T):T return items[i] = v;
}

class ReadOnly implements ArrayAccess<String> {
	public function new() {}
	public function __get(i:Int):String return "ro" + i;
}

class P {
	static function props(t:cs.system.Type):String {
		var flags = new cs.Flags(BindingFlags.Public) | BindingFlags.NonPublic | BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.DeclaredOnly;
		var ps = t.GetProperties(flags);
		var out = [];
		for (i in 0...ps.Length) out.push(ps[i].PropertyType.Name + " " + ps[i].Name + " w=" + ps[i].CanWrite);
		var dm = t.GetDefaultMembers();
		return out.join("; ") + " | default=" + [for (i in 0...dm.Length) dm[i].Name].join(",");
	}

	static function main() {
		var g = new Grid();
		Sys.println("read " + g[1]);
		Sys.println("assign value " + (g[1] = 5));
		g[0] += 2;
		Sys.println("after += " + g[0]);
		g[2]++;
		Sys.println("post++ value " + (g[2]++));
		var s = new Sub();
		Sys.println("sub read " + s[0]);
		var v = new Vec(["a", "b"]);
		v[1] = "c";
		Sys.println("vec " + v[0] + v[1]);
		var vd:Vec<Dynamic> = new Vec<Int>([1, 2]);
		Sys.println("vec dyn " + vd[0]);
		vd[1] = 7;
		Sys.println("vec dyn write " + vd[1]);
		var r = new ReadOnly();
		Sys.println("ro " + r[3]);
		Sys.println("Grid " + props(cs.Lib.toNativeType(Grid)));
		Sys.println("Sub " + props(cs.Lib.toNativeType(Sub)));
		Sys.println("Vec<String> " + props(cs.Lib.getNativeType(v)));
		Sys.println("Vec companion " + props(cs.system.Type._GetType("Vec")));
		Sys.println("ReadOnly " + props(cs.Lib.toNativeType(ReadOnly)));
		Sys.println("fields Vec " + Type.getInstanceFields(Vec));
	}
}

// gencs writes an indexer for the __get/__set that survive DCE: a class whose __get nothing reads loses both.
class Unused {
	public function new() {}
	public function __get(i:Int):Int return i;
}

	public function new() {}
	public function __get(i:Int):Int return i * 2;

		Sys.println("Used: " + (cs.Lib.getNativeType(v).GetProperty("Item") != null) + " " + Type.getInstanceFields(Used));
	}
}

# [review probe iface] An interface with __get/__set gets gencs's indexer as a C# default interface member, with
# bodies that call __get and __set; an implementing class's own indexer implements it, virtual and sealed.
--- haxe-interface-indexer @gencs
import cs.system.reflection.BindingFlags;

interface I {
	function __get(i:Int):Int;
}

interface J<T> {
	function __get(i:Int):T;
	function __set(i:Int, v:T):T;
}

class C implements I {
	public function new() {}
	public function __get(i:Int):Int return i * 2;
}

class D implements J<String> {
	var s = ["a", "b"];
	public function new() {}
	public function __get(i:Int):String return s[i];
	public function __set(i:Int, v:String):String return s[i] = v;
}

class P {
	static function accessors(t:cs.system.Type):String {
		var flags = new cs.Flags(BindingFlags.Public) | BindingFlags.NonPublic | BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.DeclaredOnly;
		var ms = t.GetMethods(flags);
		var out = [];
		for (i in 0...ms.Length) if (ms[i].Name.indexOf("_Item") >= 0) {
			var m = ms[i];
			out.push(m.Name + (m.IsVirtual ? " virtual" : "") + (m.IsFinal ? " final" : "") + (m.IsAbstract ? " abstract" : ""));
		}
		var ps = t.GetProperties(flags);
		var dm = t.GetDefaultMembers();
		return out.join(", ") + " | " + [for (i in 0...ps.Length) ps[i].Name + " w=" + ps[i].CanWrite].join(",") + " | default=" + [for (i in 0...dm.Length) dm[i].Name].join(",");
	}

	static function main() {
		var i:I = new C();
		trace(i.__get(3));
		var j:J<String> = new D();
		j.__set(1, "c");
		trace(j.__get(1));
		Sys.println("I " + accessors(cs.Lib.toNativeType(I)));
		Sys.println("J " + accessors(cs.system.Type._GetType("J`1")));
		Sys.println("C " + accessors(cs.Lib.toNativeType(C)));
		Sys.println("D " + accessors(cs.Lib.toNativeType(D)));
		var ip = cs.Lib.toNativeType(I).GetProperty("Item");
		Sys.println("I.Item via reflection " + ip.GetValue(i, cs.NativeArray.make((5 : Dynamic))));
	}
}

# @:strict on a tool model as the server app writes them: Description and Required on a @:nativeGen class's
# @:property vars (the Property row, not the backing field), Range's (int,int) and (double,double) overloads
# picked from the literal, and named arguments. The @:strict entries come out in reverse source order
# (strictMeta.ml prepends them). An argument's @:strict, which gencs does not write, is refused by hxc
# (attrs-refuse-strict-on-argument), so run's q has none. The externs are written out so the case does not
# depend on hxcs's net-20 externs having DataAnnotations.
--- serverapp-strict-tool-model @gencs
import cs.system.reflection.BindingFlags;

@:native("System.ComponentModel.DescriptionAttribute") extern class DescriptionAttribute extends cs.system.Attribute {
	public function new(d:String);
	public var Description(default, never):String;
}
@:native("System.ComponentModel.DataAnnotations.RequiredAttribute") extern class RequiredAttribute extends cs.system.Attribute {
	public function new();
	public var AllowEmptyStrings:Bool;
}
@:native("System.ComponentModel.DataAnnotations.RangeAttribute") extern class RangeAttribute extends cs.system.Attribute {
	@:overload public function new(a:Int, b:Int);
	@:overload public function new(a:Float, b:Float);
	public var Minimum(default, never):Dynamic;
	public var ErrorMessage:String;
}

// A tool model as the server app writes them: @:strict attributes on a @:nativeGen class's @:property vars.
@:nativeGen
@:strict(DescriptionAttribute("the model"))
class Search_Model {
	public function new() {}
	@:strict(DescriptionAttribute("Text to search for."))
	@:strict(RequiredAttribute)
	@:property public var text:String = "";
	@:strict(DescriptionAttribute("Maximum results."))
	@:property public var limit:Int = 10;
	@:strict(RequiredAttribute({AllowEmptyStrings: true}))
	@:strict(RangeAttribute(1, 5, {ErrorMessage: "out of range"}))
	public var plain:Int = 0;
	@:strict(RangeAttribute(1.5, 5))
	public var real:Float = 0;
	@:strict(DescriptionAttribute("a method")) public function run(q:String):Int return 0;
	@:strict(DescriptionAttribute("static")) public static function make():Search_Model return new Search_Model();
}

class P {
	static function show(a:Dynamic):String {
		if (Std.isOfType(a, DescriptionAttribute)) return "Description(" + (a : DescriptionAttribute).Description + ")";
		if (Std.isOfType(a, RangeAttribute)) { var r:RangeAttribute = a; return "Range(" + Std.string(r.Minimum) + " " + cs.Lib.toNativeType(Type.getClass(r.Minimum)).Name + ", " + r.ErrorMessage + ")"; }
		if (Std.isOfType(a, RequiredAttribute)) return "Required(" + (a : RequiredAttribute).AllowEmptyStrings + ")";
		return Std.string(a);
	}
	static function list(label:String, attrs:cs.NativeArray<Dynamic>) {
		Sys.println(label + ": " + [for (i in 0...attrs.Length) show(attrs[i])].join(" "));
	}
	static function main() {
		var t = cs.Lib.toNativeType(Search_Model);
		var all = new cs.Flags(BindingFlags.Public) | BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.Static | BindingFlags.DeclaredOnly;
		list("class", t.GetCustomAttributes(false));
		for (n in ["text", "limit"]) list("property " + n, t.GetProperty(n).GetCustomAttributes(false));
		for (n in ["plain", "real"]) list("field " + n, t.GetField(n, all).GetCustomAttributes(false));
		for (n in ["run", "make"]) list("method " + n, t.GetMethod(n, all).GetCustomAttributes(false));
		list("parameter q", t.GetMethod("run", all).GetParameters()[0].GetCustomAttributes(false));
		var bf = t.GetField("<text>k__BackingField", new cs.Flags(BindingFlags.NonPublic) | BindingFlags.Instance);
		list("backing field", bf.GetCustomAttributes(false));

# @:meta forms gencs writes: a Haxe attribute class (hxgen, so Name is a field and the named argument is
# FIELD 0x53) and a @:nativeGen one with typeof, string-array, enum, double and bool constructor overloads;
# AllowMultiple from the class's own AttributeUsage; the hxgen constructor's attributes on the
# (haxe.lang.EmptyObject) constructor; a typedef's @:meta on a parameter of that typedef's type; a
# @:nativeGen enum's @:meta on its TypeDef. gencs drops @:meta(A, B) (two parameters), an hxgen enum's
# @:meta and an enum constructor's; hxc refuses the first (attrs-refuse-meta-two-parameters) and matches the
# other two. @:noCompletion's EditorBrowsable(Never) is attrs-editor-browsable's.
--- attrs-meta-forms @gencs
import cs.system.reflection.BindingFlags;

// Attribute classes defined in Haxe: an hxgen one (fields as named arguments) and a @:nativeGen one.
@:meta(System.AttributeUsage(System.AttributeTargets.All, AllowMultiple = true))
class Tag extends cs.system.Attribute {
	public var Name:String;
	public var n:Int;
	public function new(n:Int) { super(); this.n = n; }
	public function toString():String return "Tag(" + n + (Name == null ? "" : ", Name=" + Name) + ")";
}
@:nativeGen
@:meta(System.AttributeUsage(System.AttributeTargets.All, AllowMultiple = true))
class TypeTag extends cs.system.Attribute {
	public var t:cs.system.Type;
	public var list:cs.NativeArray<String>;
	public var kind:cs.system.AttributeTargets;
	public var d:Float;
	public var b:Bool;
	public var s:String;
	@:overload public function new(t:cs.system.Type) { super(); this.t = t; }
	@:overload public function new(list:cs.NativeArray<String>) { super(); this.list = list; }
	@:overload public function new(kind:cs.system.AttributeTargets) { super(); this.kind = kind; }
	@:overload public function new(d:Float) { super(); this.d = d; }
	@:overload public function new(b:Bool) { super(); this.b = b; }
	@:overload public function new(s:String) { super(); this.s = s; }
	public function toString():String {
		return "TypeTag(" + (t != null ? "typeof " + t.FullName : list != null ? "[" + [for (i in 0...list.Length) list[i]].join(",") + "]"
			: s != null ? "s=" + s : "kind=" + Std.string(kind) + " d=" + d + " b=" + b) + ")";
	}
}

# gencs's argt_s writes a parameter's typedef @:meta on an hxgen class's real constructor and on its static
# __hx_ctor_* (after __hx_this), an inherited constructor's included.
--- attrs-constructor-parameter-typedef @gencs
import cs.system.reflection.BindingFlags;

@:meta(System.ComponentModel.DescriptionAttribute("t")) typedef Tagged = String;
class C {
	public function new(a:Tagged, n:Int) {}
}
class D extends C {}
class P {
	static function show(t:cs.system.Type) {
		var all = new cs.Flags(BindingFlags.Public) | BindingFlags.NonPublic | BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.Static | BindingFlags.DeclaredOnly;
		var lines = [];
		var cs_ = t.GetConstructors(all);
		for (i in 0...cs_.Length) lines.push(Std.string(cs_[i]) + " " + params(cs_[i].GetParameters()));
		var ms = t.GetMethods(all);
		for (i in 0...ms.Length) if (StringTools.startsWith(ms[i].Name, "__hx_ctor")) lines.push(ms[i].Name + " " + params(ms[i].GetParameters()));
		lines.sort(Reflect.compare);
		for (l in lines) Sys.println(t.Name + ": " + l);
	}
	static function params(ps:cs.NativeArray<cs.system.reflection.ParameterInfo>):String {
		return [for (i in 0...ps.Length) ps[i].Name + "[" + [for (a in ps[i].GetCustomAttributes(false)) Std.string(a)].join(",") + "]"].join(" ");
	}
	static function main() {
		new D("x", 1);
		show(cs.Lib.toNativeType(C));
		show(cs.Lib.toNativeType(D));
	}
}

// relies on StructLayout(Explicit) and FieldOffset(0) to reinterpret a float's bits.

	@:meta(System.Runtime.InteropServices.FieldOffset(0)) public var f:Single;

		var s = cs.Lib.toNativeType(Ser);

# A @:nativeGen class's constructor and methods get an overload per trailing optional argument (gencs.ml
# get_overloads_for_optional_args), the constructors chaining with : this(...). The parameterless one is
# what Type.createEmptyInstance and SK's model construction need; hxc today has only the full overloads and
# createEmptyInstance throws MissingMethodException.
--- attrs-nativegen-optional-overloads @gencs
import cs.system.reflection.BindingFlags;
// gencs gives a @:nativeGen class's constructor and methods an overload per trailing optional argument.
@:nativeGen class NG {
	public var a:Int;
	public function new(?x:Int, y:String = "y") { a = x == null ? 9 : x; }
	public function opt(a:Int, ?b:Int, c:String = "c"):String return a + "," + b + "," + c;
	public static function sopt(?z:Float):String return "z=" + z;
}
class P {
	static function main() {
		var t = cs.Lib.toNativeType(NG);
		var all = new cs.Flags(BindingFlags.Public) | BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.Static | BindingFlags.DeclaredOnly;
		var ms = t.GetMethods(all);
		var sigs = [for (i in 0...ms.Length) Std.string(ms[i])];

# Ruling 7: a default other than null is passed to the full method, a generic @:nativeGen class's overloads
# call the full method through its own instantiation (a static's through G<object>, as gencs writes it), and
# each overload of a @:noCompletion method is EditorBrowsable too.
--- attrs-nativegen-optional-overloads-generic @gencs
import cs.system.componentmodel.EditorBrowsableAttribute;
@:nativeGen class G<T> {
	public var v:T;
	public function new(?v:T, n:Int = 5) { this.v = v; Sys.println("new " + v + " " + n); }
	@:noCompletion public function m(a:String, b:Int = 7, f:Float = 1.5, ?c:Bool):String return a + b + f + c;
	public static function s(x:Int = 3):Int return x * 2;

	static function main() {
		var t = cs.Lib.toNativeType(G);
		var all = new cs.Flags(cs.system.reflection.BindingFlags.Public) | cs.system.reflection.BindingFlags.Instance | cs.system.reflection.BindingFlags.Static | cs.system.reflection.BindingFlags.DeclaredOnly;
		var lines = [];
		var ms:Array<cs.system.reflection.MethodBase> = [for (m in t.GetMethods(all)) m];
		for (c in t.GetConstructors(all)) ms.push(c);
		for (m in ms) {
			var e:EditorBrowsableAttribute = cast cs.system.Attribute.GetCustomAttribute(m, cs.Lib.toNativeType(EditorBrowsableAttribute));
			lines.push(Std.string(m) + " " + (e == null ? "-" : Std.string(e.State)));
		}
		lines.sort(Reflect.compare);
		for (l in lines) Sys.println(l);

		Sys.println(g.v == null);
		Sys.println(gt.GetMethod("m", cs.NativeArray.make(cs.Lib.toNativeType(String))).Invoke(g, cs.NativeArray.make(("x" : Dynamic))));
		Sys.println(gt.GetMethod("s", new cs.NativeArray(0)).Invoke(null, new cs.NativeArray(0)));
	}

# Divergence (ruling 7): each optional-argument overload, and the full method, carries the field's
# attributes once, from @:meta or @:strict. gencs writes the method's attributes in front of its first
# overload, which then has them twice and the full method none, so its C# does not compile for an attribute

	}

# Nullable metadata: the server app's build puts `#nullable enable` before every `namespace ai.tools {` of
# gencs's output, and SK reads NullabilityInfoContext for the AI tool schemas. -D dotnet-nullable=<package>
# (proposed) does the same for the modules of that package: every type of the module, other.Plain included
# (the C# file is enabled from its first `namespace tools {` on). [run] is gencs's output with the server
# app's patch applied by hand to g/src/tools/P.cs (verified); [gencs] is what the harness's unpatched gencs
# build prints. Null<Int> (haxe.lang.Null<int>, a struct) and Nullable<int> read the same either way.
--- attrs-nullable-opt-in @gencs @module=tools.P + -D dotnet-nullable=tools
package tools;

import cs.system.collections.generic.List_1;
import cs.system.Nullable_1;

@:native("System.Reflection.NullabilityInfoContext") extern class NullabilityInfoContext {
	function new();
	@:overload function Create(p:cs.system.reflection.PropertyInfo):NullabilityInfo;
	@:overload function Create(p:cs.system.reflection.ParameterInfo):NullabilityInfo;
	@:overload function Create(f:cs.system.reflection.FieldInfo):NullabilityInfo;
}
@:native("System.Reflection.NullabilityInfo") extern class NullabilityInfo {
	var ReadState(default, never):NullabilityState;
	var GenericTypeArguments(default, never):cs.NativeArray<NullabilityInfo>;
	var ElementType(default, never):NullabilityInfo;
}
@:native("System.Reflection.NullabilityState") extern enum NullabilityState { Unknown; NotNull; Nullable; }

// The namespace the server app's build patches with `#nullable enable` (here `tools`).
@:nativeGen class Model {
	public function new() {}
	@:property public var name:String = "";
	@:property public var count:Int = 0;
	@:property public var maybe:Null<String> = null;
	@:property public var tags:List_1<String> = new List_1<String>();
	@:property public var when:Nullable_1<Int> = null;
	@:property public var boxed:Null<Int> = null;
	@:property public var any:Dynamic = null;
	@:property public var arr:cs.NativeArray<String> = null;
	public var field:String = "";
	public function run(q:String, n:Null<Int>):String return q;
}
@:nativeGen @:native("other.Plain") class Plain {
	public function new() {}
	@:property public var name:String = "";
}

class P {
	static function state(i:NullabilityInfo):String {
		if (i == null) return "-";
		var s = Std.string(i.ReadState);
		var args = i.GenericTypeArguments;
		if (args.Length > 0) s += "<" + [for (k in 0...args.Length) state(args[k])].join(",") + ">";
		if (i.ElementType != null) s += "[" + state(i.ElementType) + "]";
		return s;
	}
	static function main() {
		var ctx = new NullabilityInfoContext();
		var t = cs.Lib.toNativeType(Model);
		for (n in ["name", "count", "maybe", "tags", "when", "boxed", "any", "arr"]) Sys.println(n + " " + state(ctx.Create(t.GetProperty(n))));
		Sys.println("field " + state(ctx.Create(t.GetField("field"))));
		var m = t.GetMethod("run");
		var ps = m.GetParameters();
		Sys.println("run(q " + state(ctx.Create(ps[0])) + ", n " + state(ctx.Create(ps[1])) + ") returns " + state(ctx.Create(m.ReturnParameter)));
		Sys.println("Plain.name " + state(ctx.Create(cs.Lib.toNativeType(Plain).GetProperty("name"))));
	}
}

# -resource files: each is the manifest resource "src.Resources." + the name escaped as haxe.Resource escapes it
# (Path.escape(name, true): every UTF-16 code unit but A-Z a-z 0-9 _ . / \ becomes -x<code>), so a name with
# slashes, dots or "Resources." in it round-trips. gencs.csproj.in embeds gencs's src/Resources under the names
# hxcs gives csc. The harness writes P.hx with a final empty line: 555 bytes.
--- resource-file-names @gencs + --resource P.hx@P.hx --resource P.hx@dir/sub/p.txt --resource P.hx@with-dash.and.dots --resource P.hx@.leading --resource P.hx@UPPER --resource P.hx@x/Resources.y --resource P.hx@Resources.x --resource P.hx@a_b
class P {
	static function main() {
		var names = haxe.Resource.listNames();
		Sys.println(names);
		for (n in names) {
			var b = haxe.Resource.getBytes(n);
			Sys.println(n + " " + (haxe.Resource.getString(n) == b.toString()) + " " + b.length + " " + haxe.crypto.Md5.make(b).toHex());
		}
		var asm = cs.Lib.toNativeType(P).Assembly;
		var mn = asm.GetManifestResourceNames();
		var all = [for (i in 0...mn.Length) mn[i]];
		all.sort(Reflect.compare);
		for (n in all) Sys.println("manifest " + n + " " + asm.GetManifestResourceStream(n).Length);
	}
}

# A macro's Context.addResource: binary data (all 256 byte values), an empty resource, a UTF-8 BOM (kept:
# getString does not strip it), CRLF, and a nested name, read back through haxe.Resource and through
# Assembly.GetManifestResourceStream. hxc at 7df87731 drops macro resources silently (EvalStdLib
# add_resource writes only the interpreter's own map), compiles with no error and throws in listNames.
--- resource-macro-binary @gencs + --macro P.addRes()

#if macro
class P {
	static function addRes() {
		var all = haxe.io.Bytes.alloc(256);
		for (i in 0...256) all.set(i, i);
		haxe.macro.Context.addResource("all256.bin", all);
		haxe.macro.Context.addResource("empty", haxe.io.Bytes.alloc(0));
		haxe.macro.Context.addResource("bom.txt", haxe.io.Bytes.ofHex("efbbbf626f6d"));
		haxe.macro.Context.addResource("utf8.txt", haxe.io.Bytes.ofString("h\u00e9llo \u20ac \u{1F600}\r\n"));
		haxe.macro.Context.addResource("dir/sub/deep.bin", all.sub(128, 128));
	}
}

#else
class P {
	static function hex(b:haxe.io.Bytes):String {
		return b == null ? "null" : b.length + ":" + haxe.crypto.Md5.make(b).toHex();
	}
	static function main() {
		var names = haxe.Resource.listNames();
		names.sort(Reflect.compare);
		for (n in names) Sys.println(n + " " + hex(haxe.Resource.getBytes(n)));
		var all = haxe.Resource.getBytes("all256.bin");
		var ok = all.length == 256;
		for (i in 0...256) if (all.get(i) != i) ok = false;
		Sys.println("all256 " + ok);
		var s = haxe.Resource.getString("utf8.txt");
		Sys.println("utf8 " + s.length + " " + StringTools.urlEncode(s));
		var bom = haxe.Resource.getString("bom.txt");
		Sys.println("bom " + bom.length + " " + bom.charCodeAt(0));
		Sys.println("empty [" + haxe.Resource.getString("empty") + "] " + hex(haxe.Resource.getBytes("empty")));
		// What C# code reading the assembly's manifest resources sees.
		var asm = cs.Lib.toNativeType(P).Assembly;
		var mn = asm.GetManifestResourceNames();
		var sorted = [for (i in 0...mn.Length) mn[i]];
		sorted.sort(Reflect.compare);
		for (n in sorted) {
			var st = asm.GetManifestResourceStream(n);
			var buf = new cs.NativeArray<cs.types.UInt8>(cast st.Length);
			var got = st.Read(buf, 0, buf.Length);
			Sys.println("manifest " + n + " " + hex(haxe.io.Bytes.ofData(buf)) + " read=" + got);
		}
		var info = asm.GetManifestResourceInfo("src.Resources.all256.bin");
		Sys.println("location " + info.ResourceLocation);
	}
}

#end

# listNames() is the reverse of the order OCaml's Hashtbl.iter visits the names (Context.resourceFoldOrder in
# hxc, already used by the jvm and cpp generators), with -resource and macro names in one table; a name
# added again keeps its place and takes the new bytes. hxc writes the ManifestResource rows in

#if macro

	static function addRes() {
		for (i in 0...60) haxe.macro.Context.addResource("many/m" + i, haxe.io.Bytes.ofString("m" + i));

		haxe.macro.Context.addResource("many/m7", haxe.io.Bytes.ofString("replaced"));
	}
}

	static function main() {
		// listNames is the reverse of the hash table's bucket order, not the order the names were added in.
		Sys.println(haxe.Resource.listNames().join(","));

		Sys.println(cs.Lib.toNativeType(P).Assembly.GetManifestResourceNames().Length);

}

# Two names that escape to one manifest name ("\x01" + "2" and "\x0c" are both -x12): gencs writes one file over
# the other (csc: CS1508 duplicate resource; MSBuild: both names read the same bytes, as below). hxc refuses.
--- resource-escape-collision-is-an-error + --macro P.addRes()

#if macro
class P {
	static function addRes() {
		// "\x01" then "2", and "\x0c": both escape to -x12.
		haxe.macro.Context.addResource(String.fromCharCode(1) + "2", haxe.io.Bytes.ofString("one-two"));
		haxe.macro.Context.addResource(String.fromCharCode(12), haxe.io.Bytes.ofString("twelve"));
	}
}

#else
class P {

# The same collision from the command line: "{" (123) and form feed (12) + "3" both escape to -x123. The
# pair needs a control character because "!5" and U+014F, the printable pair, cannot be passed: the compiler

# The ManifestResource rows are in the order the compile holds the resources (Context.resourceFoldOrder, the
# order hxcs passes them to csc), and haxe.Resource.listNames() is the reverse of that. GetManifestResourceNames()
# lists the rows in table order, so unsorted it shows both. Not @gencs: MSBuild reorders the rows. A reversed
# embed loop would print the second line as the first.
--- resource-manifest-row-order + --resource P.hx@zeta --resource P.hx@alpha --resource P.hx@mid/dir.txt --resource P.hx@Beta --resource P.hx@a.b --resource P.hx@_u --resource P.hx@k9
class P {
	static function main() {
		var names = haxe.Resource.listNames();
		Sys.println(names.join(","));
		var mn = cs.Lib.toNativeType(P).Assembly.GetManifestResourceNames();
		var all = [for (i in 0...mn.Length) mn[i]];
		Sys.println(all.join(","));
		var rev = all.copy();
		rev.reverse();
		var same = rev.length == names.length;
		for (i in 0...rev.length) if (rev[i] != "src.Resources." + names[i]) same = false;
		Sys.println("rows are listNames reversed: " + same);
	}
}

# Events defined in Haxe (4c): an @:event var with add_/remove_ bodies is a C# event whose public accessors call
# the bodies, renamed _add_X/_remove_X and private (gencs's gen_event). Haxe calls of add_X/remove_X go through
# the accessors (gencs writes s.Changed += h). The var is no field and no reflection field (@:skipReflection);
# Type.getInstanceFields sees the event through .NET reflection.
--- event-custom-instance-and-static @gencs
import cs.system.EventHandler;
import cs.system.EventArgs;
import cs.system.reflection.BindingFlags;

class Src {
	public function new() {}
	@:event var Changed:EventHandler;
	var handlers:EventHandler;
	public function add_Changed(h:EventHandler):Void {
		Sys.println("add_Changed");
		handlers = handlers + h;
	}
	public function remove_Changed(h:EventHandler):Void {
		Sys.println("remove_Changed");
		handlers = handlers - h;
	}
	public function fire(tag:String) {
		if (handlers != null) handlers.Invoke(tag, EventArgs.Empty) else Sys.println("nobody for " + tag);
	}

	@:event static var SChanged:EventHandler;
	static var shandlers:EventHandler;
	public static function add_SChanged(h:EventHandler):Void {
		Sys.println("add_SChanged");
		shandlers = shandlers + h;
	}
	public static function remove_SChanged(h:EventHandler):Void {
		shandlers = shandlers - h;
	}
	public static function sfire(tag:String) {
		if (shandlers != null) shandlers.Invoke(tag, EventArgs.Empty) else Sys.println("nobody for " + tag);
	}
}

class P {
	static function main() {
		var s = new Src();
		var h = new EventHandler((o:Dynamic, e:EventArgs) -> Sys.println("handler got " + o));
		s.add_Changed(h);
		s.fire("a");
		s.remove_Changed(h);
		s.fire("b");
		Src.add_SChanged(h);
		Src.sfire("c");
		Src.remove_SChanged(h);
		Src.sfire("d");
		// What C# sees: an event per @:event var, whose public accessors call the Haxe add_/remove_.
		var t = cs.Lib.toNativeType(Src);
		var all = new cs.Flags(BindingFlags.Public) | BindingFlags.NonPublic | BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.Static | BindingFlags.DeclaredOnly;
		var evs = t.GetEvents(all);
		for (i in 0...evs.Length) {
			var e = evs[i];
			var add = e.GetAddMethod(true), rem = e.GetRemoveMethod(true);
			Sys.println("event " + e.Name + " : " + e.EventHandlerType + " attrs=" + e.Attributes + " add=" + add.Name + " (" + add.Attributes + ")"
				+ " remove=" + rem.Name + " (" + rem.Attributes + ")");
		}
		var fs = t.GetFields(all);
		var names = [for (i in 0...fs.Length) fs[i].Name];
		names.sort(Reflect.compare);
		Sys.println("fields " + names);
		// C#'s `s.Changed += h`, through reflection.
		t.GetEvent("Changed").AddEventHandler(s, (cast h : cs.system.Delegate));
		s.fire("e");
		t.GetEvent("SChanged").AddEventHandler(null, (cast h : cs.system.Delegate));
		Src.sfire("f");
		// Haxe reflection reaches add_/remove_ as methods, and the event var is no field of it.
		Reflect.callMethod(s, Reflect.field(s, "remove_Changed"), [h]);
		s.fire("g");
		Sys.println(Reflect.fields(s));
		Sys.println(Type.getInstanceFields(Src).filter(f -> f.indexOf("Changed") >= 0));
		Sys.println(Type.getClassFields(Src).filter(f -> f.indexOf("Changed") >= 0));
	}
}

# C# code subscribes to a Haxe-defined event with `+=` and `-=` (here through reflection, from an object only known
# at run time) and the Haxe body runs; for the static event the object is its Type.
--- event-csharp-subscribes @gencs @netlib=EvLib
import ev.*;

class Src {
	public function new() {}
	@:event var Changed:Note;
	var handlers:Note;
	public function add_Changed(h:Note):Void {
		Sys.println("add_Changed");
		handlers = handlers + h;
	}
	public function remove_Changed(h:Note):Void {
		Sys.println("remove_Changed");
		handlers = handlers - h;
	}
	public function fire(s:String) {
		if (handlers != null) handlers.Invoke(s) else Sys.println("nobody for " + s);
	}

	@:event static var SChanged:Note;
	static var shandlers:Note;
	public static function add_SChanged(h:Note):Void {
		Sys.println("add_SChanged");
		shandlers = shandlers + h;
	}
	public static function remove_SChanged(h:Note):Void {
		Sys.println("remove_SChanged");
		shandlers = shandlers - h;
	}
	public static function sfire(s:String) {
		if (shandlers != null) shandlers.Invoke(s) else Sys.println("nobody for " + s);
	}
}

class P {
	static function main() {
		var s = new Src();
		var d = Use.Attach(s, "Changed", "cs");
		s.fire("a");
		Use.Detach(s, "Changed", d);
		s.fire("b");

		s.add_Changed(h);
		var d2 = Use.Attach(s, "Changed", "cs2");
		s.fire("e");
		Use.Detach(s, "Changed", d2);
		s.remove_Changed(h);
		s.fire("f");
	}
}

# A @:nativeGen generic class has no companion interface for its accessors to clash with, so gencs's C# compiles its
# events (and a static event of any generic class); their accessors reach the private bodies through the class's own
# instantiation.
--- event-nativegen-generic-class @gencs

import cs.system.EventArgs;

		Sys.println("add");
		handlers = handlers + h;
	}
	public function remove_Changed(h:EventHandler):Void handlers = handlers - h;
	public function fire() if (handlers != null) handlers.Invoke("x", EventArgs.Empty);
	@:event static var SChanged:EventHandler;
	static var sh:EventHandler;
	public static function add_SChanged(h:EventHandler):Void {
		Sys.println("sadd");
		sh = sh + h;
	}
	public static function remove_SChanged(h:EventHandler):Void sh = sh - h;
	public static function sfire() if (sh != null) sh.Invoke("s", EventArgs.Empty);

		g.fire();
		G.add_SChanged(new EventHandler((o:Dynamic, e:EventArgs) -> Sys.println("sgot " + o)));
		G.sfire();
		Sys.println(cs.Lib.toNativeType(G).GetEvents().Length);
	}
}

--- event-field-like-outside-class-is-an-error
import cs.system.EventHandler;

class A {
	public function new() {}
	@:event var Changed:EventHandler;
	public function add_Changed(h:EventHandler):Void {}
	public function remove_Changed(h:EventHandler):Void {}
	@:event static var SChanged:EventHandler;
	public static function add_SChanged(h:EventHandler):Void {}
	public static function remove_SChanged(h:EventHandler):Void {}
	public function viaLambda() {
		var f = () -> Changed == null;
		return f();
	}
}

class B extends A {
	public function new() super();

# gencs writes no attribute on an event: the @:meta of an @:event var is dropped. The custom event's attribute
# on the Haxe add_ stays on its private body _add_, and the field-like event's accessors have only
